La localisation est vraiment top. C'est spacieux. Le lave-linge et le congélateur sont un plus. Les informations sur la région laissées par John nous ont été très utiles.En revanche, il y avait une mauvaise odeur (moquette, salle de bain, aspirateur).
Our second time here and just suits us who have no plans. access to everywhere.A very nice and comfortable house and Breda helpful as always.
It was a lovely stay and so easy to get around. The only problem we had was the noise from the pub opposite which was extremely lively until gone 2 in the morning.
Shauna was a lovely host very welcoming, the house was spotlessly clean and the location was brill for me as I had a course nearby in banteer. Thank you
Annette’s place was perfect for us going to a concert in slane. She was very responsive to our messages and could accommodate an early check in. She gave us great local recommendations too!

Great location. Good for joining bus tours and really easy to walk into the city. Apartment was clean, well appointed and very comfortable. As it is part of the lodge, you could even get breakfast there (not included) which was very convenient. Host was very responsive. Would recommend this place.

Birds place was great she met us at the door and was more than welcoming. House itself had everything it said and more . She even left us out bread milk butter snacks and wine which was very kind .Took me wife me mum dad and me son and everyone loved it clean comfortable and really cosy with turf fire burning away . Beds were great to . Really recommend and of course Donegal is a magical place .
Great hosts very friendly and welcoming, messaged lina for an extra pillowwas with me in 5 mins, would recommend and stay again

A lovely place to stay very close to the centre in Ballycotton with easy parking. Very quite and a beautiful view from the room I stayed in. Maria was very friendly, helpful and easy to communicate with. She even provided me with a nice continental breakfast.
I can recommend this place.

we stayed at Sheila's place to catch an early flight out of Dublin. It's less than 30 mins of driving. She warmly greeted us in person. The place was homey and the bed was comfy. Bread, butter and jam with juice, milk, coffee and tea were provided

This house is fab!So tastefully decorated, so clean, has all home comforts, so easy to find everything with the gorgeous pantry, a toy corner for the kids. Michelle has thought of everything and was a lovely host! Really enjoyed our stay was peaceful and relaxing but yet only 30 mins to Kildare shopping village, less than an hour to Glendalough and we had a fab brunch in Grangecon kitchen in the village. Supervalu in Baltinglas only 5 minute drive away too if you need to pick up few bits. You won't be disappointed if you book this house🤗

I was looking for a place in the middle of nature to calm down, far away from big cities. Christian's chalet was therefore a perfect fit. It has everything you need to enjoy a few days. Above all, you have a beautiful view and you can walk to the beach in two minutes.10/10 I will come back!
What a gorgeous apartment, it really felt like going "home" every evening after all the activities around beautiful Mayo!
Great host, very kind and helpful.

We enjoyed our stay and Gerry’s place is as shown in the photos. We felt there needed to be a few little things. A couple more lamps (none in the 3 bed ) and a wardrobe in each room would have been good. as very little hanging space. It would have been nice to have a few extra things in the kitchen. Some serving bowls/platters and a couple of chopping/cheese boards. Also some storage in the bathrooms. The beds were comfortable but the floors are very squeaky upstairs. So no sneaking about. Haha. Overall, Gerry’s place is comfortable with great heating as we were there in a particularly cold snap.
Very friendly and reliable Super clean and cozy placeplus private bathroom it's deffo a plus

Très joli guest house à côté de la maison principale dans une propriété spacieuse.Brian, amical et accueillant, à facilité notre arrivée. Toutes les commodité sur place plus un joli petit dej maison et un apéritif vin et quelques chips laissés à notre attention.Merci pour tout Je recommande
Lovely cottage near bantry. Had everything we needed.
We loved Kilkenny, great town. Had a good, informative bike tour and a wonderful drive in the country. Public transit was close enough to walk to.

Très bon emplacement avec le train pour le centre de Dublin à quelques minutes à pied. Et si l'on veut manger pas loin, il y a un super resto pub, The Carpenter, accessible à une quinzaine de minutes à pied. Il propose aussi des petits déjeuners.J'avais peur de mal dormir avec les bruits de train mais ça ne nous a pas gêné ( il ne doit pas trop circuler la nuit), c'était très calme par ailleurs. La chambre est un peu petite. Un plus est d'avoir accès à la cuisine/ salle à manger pour préparer un repas rapide et pour le petit déjeuner ( café soluble et thé disponibles + beurre de cacahuète, il n'y a plus qu'à prévoir les toasts). Ce qui m'a dérangé est qu'il était indiqué sur l'annonce que la salle de bain était privée ce qui n'était pas le cas. En conclusion un bon rapport qualité/ prix, je n'hésiterai pas à revenir.
We had an absolutely brilliant weekend. The house is gorgeous and West Cork was stunning. Also, Jerome was an excellent host- great communication and recommendations. We will be back!

We had such a lovely stay in Kinvarra! Sorcha was a great host and made us feel very welcome. Room and bathroom were super spacious, clean and cosy :) I really loved the interior design. Thanks again Sorcha!

Everything about my stay exceeded expectations. The view alone is spectacular and I will most definitely be back again. This was perfect for me as a solo traveller but would be equally as good for a couple staying. John and Noreen have thought of everything and it felt like a home from home.
This is the second time we have stayed at the cottage and it felt like coming home! We loved the subtle holiday decorations and nothing beats the view! We look forward to our next visit! Thanks Liam!

Unkomplizierter Check-in per Schlüsselbox, gute Kommunikation. Ein modern eingerichtetes, großzügig geschnittenes Apartment in einem typischen irischen Hinterhof. An sich ruhig und doch nur wenige Gehminuten vom Zentrum entfernt. Als wir dort waren, waren tagsüber im Vorderhaus Bauarbeiten und abends waren die Gespräche der Pub-Besucher im Garten nebenan bis weit in die Nacht zu hören. Trotzdem super Lage.
Nice and lovely accommodation. My friends and I enjoyed that very much. Spacious house with lots of beds and wifi in place.
Sue was great to help us find our way around, fast to respond and always available to our needs.. Very appreciated!!🙏🏼💖

Ricky's cottage was the perfect way to shut off for a few days. Nothing but sounds of birds and nature surrounding it for miles. The cottage is located within a short driving distance from two towns but is far enough away that you can be disconnected from everything. Very well equipped. Would highly recommend it. We are looking forward to staying again when the hot tub has been installed!
Great house within a 15/20 minute walk of Dingle! Such an easy check in process and Kevin was great with his communication, answering any questions we had within minutes! Would definitely stay again
Beautiful house, really central and easy to access.. lovely hosts
Je conseil ce logement. Bien situé Grace est une hôte qui s est recevoir et est a l écoute du client. Je la conseillerais a mes amis

It was a really beautiful home, well stocked, John and Corona were very helpful. Despite a little misunderstanding(from my end) at the start we sorted things out swiftly and everything else went smoothly. Had the best weekend with my girls. Thank you Corona & John.
Great location with all needed facilities and included breakfast.
Spent a night here on a cycling trip.Kathleen was wonderful to talk to. The bed was very comfortable and all facilities top-class.

Staying at Wildflower cottage and wandering around Clifden was a highlight of our trip. The cottage is perfect and just as described. So clean with everything you could need. Caroline had scones and a fire waiting for use when we arrived later than expected. Communicating with here was easy. And she always made us feel welcome. We loved it so much we decided to stay a third day. We rented bikes in town and went on a bike trip with a picnic lunch. We explored Clifden castle, had wonderful pub lunches, hiked in the Connemara National Park and listened to traditional Irish music at night. It was a grand three days!
We had a great time and the pub downstairs gave a big plus to our experience. Will definitely come back again. 10/10
Second time staying. Ideal location
Fantastic location very central. Would recommend this apartment very clean and spacious.
Great location and apartment. The host was very nice to deal with.
Couldn’t recommend enough. House was fabulous great service

Mary ist eine großartige Gastgeberin. Sie hat uns mit Tee und Kuchen begrüßt und wir haben uns sofort wie zu Hause gefühlt. Unsere Zimmer mit bequemen Betten waren sehr schön, ebenso das große Bad! Die Umgebung ist auch wunderschön und sehr ruhig. Morgens beim Frühstück haben wir von Mary viele Tipps für den Tag bekommen. Wir können diese Unterkunft sehr empfehlen ... vielen Dank an Mary und ihre Familie!
Lovely house and Rhona is a lovey person. Definitely looking forward to come back.

We booked Geraldine's place for 3 nights hoping to do multiple activities such as walking hiking and exploring but due to the storm Bella we spent most of our time in the cottage in front of the fireplace playing board games and watching Christmas movies which turned out to be the most relaxing and stress free 3 days ever. The cottage has everything you need for your stay and more. The views are just spectacular, each room window has its own picture perfect landscape. Next time we are on this side of the island I know where we gonna stay at :)

We loved out stay at Richard’s! Linda recommended us some restaurants and pubs and Richard recommended us to hire some bikes to explore the beautiful area. Clear and fast communication and the apartment looks just like the pictures. People in Cong are lovely!

We had a lovely, relaxing stay here. The place itself is clean, spacious and comfortable. The bed was incredibly comfy and the shower was fantastic. The place itself is quiet, has nice grounds to explore and is a five minute drive away from the town. The hot tub is wonderful and there’s a very handy system to book in for it. We would love to come back again some time!

Don't let the "shipping container" label fool you! The attention and care that Carol and Jimmy put into building this great little hide away was just brilliant. Great use of the space, amazing view from inside and out on the front deck and everything was as tidy and neat as could be. It really is the perfect "nest" for a few days stay. If you are looking to enjoy the Irish countryside and coast really no need to look any further.Easy access to Liscanor, Lahinch, Doolin and the legendary Cliffs of Moher (pro tip - hike to them from the south end on the Liscanor Doolin Trail) as described and avoid the crowds and tour busses you will not regret it.All in all just a great place to visit whether you are from afar or from Ireland and looking to get out of the city for a long weekend - they are marvelous hosts and I hope you try the soda bread and jam they leave for you, we CRUSHED it -you will love the "shipping container" - Slainte!
Very good value room which was clean and comfortable. We really enjoyed the Vine Thai restaurant which is 10-15 mins walk.

This spot was perfect for a weekend trip to Galway with my brother and sister-in-law! Loved the prime location for late nights out, and having two full bathrooms was wonderful! Everything was clean and well-equipped, and check in and check-out were both very easy! It was the perfect place for our weekend getaway!

This place is amazing! So peaceful. New construction. Very clean. Breathtaking views. Thoughtful extra touches. Close to the Cliffs of Moher. This cottage was everything we could have wanted and more. Amy was a wonderful host and communicated very quickly with us. Highly, highly recommend.

we have just returned from a wonderful stay in Mira in Dunfanaghy. the house is so cosy and comfortable, in a great location just a minutes walk from the lovely shops, bars and restaurants! the house had everything we needed, the beds were so comfy, and we loved the wood burning stove in the evenings to add to the Donegal atmosphere. The kids loved being able to see the horse just over the back wall and they enjoyed the great sweet shop too! Elaine and Bhavash were friendly and efficient to deal with online, and we found check-in and check-out easy and stress-free. we will definitely return!
A fantastic house and host. If your lucky enough for this to be available I suggest you book it. I look forward to returning. Liz went over and above for us. 5 stars all round.

The cottage was superb. Exactly as described and in the photos. Peaceful with beautiful surroundings. Myles and co were extremely hospitable! Went out their way to help the family settle in. Would highly recommend.

We received a lovely warm welcome to the cottage… it was incredibly comfortable, warm and SPOTLESS. We really enjoyed our time there. The hosts were easy to communicate with and prompt with their replies!
Great place to stay, i definitely recommend to anyone.

Beautiful place and close to town for walking and exploring. I love to unplug and didn’t realize that it would be an issue, but be aware that with no WiFi you can’t get in touch with anyone unless you can use your phone for phone calls which we couldn’t unless we had WiFi. Other than that, a wonderful stay!!
This Airbnb was everything we could have hoped for. Amazing view, a short walk from the beach. Warm and friendly hosts, and best of all an amazing porridge for breakfast! Couldn't recommend enough.
Everything was great thanks Zieta !
Sandra’s apartment is clean and comfortable and an easy walk into town. We appreciated the use of the washing machine and also Sandra’s dinner recommendation, Kin Khao, which we enjoyed.

We had a fabulous stay with Vinny and Anthony. Vinny was very friendly and accommodating when we arrived early, helping facilitate our baggage storage and an early check in. He gave loads of great tips about the area, and even let us hold the cannonball!! Their house is very interesting and comfortable, we really enjoyed hanging out in the main room and using WiFi while making plans. They provide a lovely selection of coffee, tea, and snacks to their guests. The beds were very comfortable and shared bathroom very clean and readily available. Street Parking was free on Sunday and then available in a nearby lot for a nominal fee. Overall we highly recommend staying in this unique inn!
Second time staying at this immaculately clean house. Walking distance to carlingford town and plenty of parking on the drive
Beautiful location and the cottage was fabulous. Finished to a high standard and everything had been thought of.
Peter's place is lovely and cosy perfect country get away,would highly recommend to anyone
Great location a short walk from Redbarn beach and the boardwalk into Youghal. Spacious bedrooms and all necessary appliances. Complimentary access to gym and pool a plus.

This was hands down the best Airbnb stay I’ve ever had! Sinead and her family were absolutely lovely. There was a storm coming in so she let us delay our checkout and they helped us understand the Irish weather system. We had a wonderful stay and would come back here if we are in the area again!
very central to all lehinch has to offer and set back from the road for peace and quiet as well.

It was a flying visit but the accommodation was flawless, we had no need to contact Órla as everything worked as it should and her information/instructions was clear concise and very helpful . Would stay again and would definitely recommend to others.

One of the best accommodations we've stayed in. Mike, our host, was friendly, kind, and a wonderful storyteller. He took us to visit the cliffs and we saw seals and seal pups and learned the history of the house and local folklore from his rich and entertaining stories. Also saw stunning sunsets from the clifftop. The house is in a beautiful clifftop location and the nearby beaches of Ballybunion are sandy and pristine. The walk above these beaches is breathtakingly beautiful with the Nuns Beach like a picture postcard. Thank you Mike and Eilish for a very memorable and nost hospitable stay in a superbly renovated warm and cosy farmhouse. Thank you for the special touches you have added which made our stay so comfortable, and thank you for your amazing warm hospitality. We would definitely love to return.

This place is full of charm, fantastic views and the most amazing host. I was wanting a central location for exploring parts of the west coast and it delivered. There is so much to see and do in the area, all within an hour drive at most. We also loved coming back every evening and sitting in front of the fire. We were very comfortable and loved every minute here.

Sinéad was the most lovely hostess.. a true 5+ stars all around. Will definitely return when back on Inishmore. My arrival plans were disrupted with airline challenges, and Sinéad went above and beyond to accommodate fluid changes and ensure my holiday was the very best. Utterly enchanting island and the most friendly locals. Míle buíochas! 🙏💚

This is truly a special property so close to the center of Cork with priceless views across the western skyline while hidden to the world in a beautiful private canopy. The treehouse itself is a masterpiece of design and the surrounding garden provides a perfect entrance. Ted, the dog is clearly well trained, don’t worry about him. Richard described everything in plenty of accurate detail, but may have been a bit too humble in the description, this place is spectacular. Delicious warm baked croissants arrived by basket for us in the morning while we sat on the porch with coffee enjoying the skyline and a game of cribbage. A curious Redbreast Robin came to pick up the crumbs from breakfast, a great indication for this urban Oasis. I’ve never seen anything like this place. If you can, book it now. You won’t regret it.
Great place to stay when starting/ending the Wicklow Way. Very kind hosts and very helpfull! Would recomand any time!
Lovely big house, loads of room for a big group get together, stunning views over the valley
Lovely little cottage perfect and beautiful location, junie is a lovely host the cottage was spotless, everything was there will be looking forward for my next stay here thanks junie
We had a really great stay - place was very comfortable and so close to the centre of Greystones - it was perfect for what we needed, thanks very much again Paul!
logement simple et correct Propre Bon accueil et gentillesse de notre hôte
Very centrally located apartment.
Très belle région (Kerry) . A découvrir Appartement bien situé
Clean and peaceful. Lots to see and do in the area.

Eva was a wonderful host. She and her son (Gabriel) were very welcoming and responded back to texts immediately. They also gave us a list of things that we could do, restaurants, and grocery stores. Overall, it was a lovely experience 🥰 10/10 would stay with them again!

A very charming property, in a calm and private setting close to Ballydehob. Very homely and well-equipped house with plenty of living space. Outdoor area for dining also and large garden/field for children to play. Ten minute drive to shops, restaurants. The beautiful landscape of West Cork on your doorstep. Thanks to Pat for his quick responses and tips.

Realmente a casa de Yves é adorável,tudo perfeito exceto ao check in, tem opção de qual hora você gostaria de chegar, e na verdade você não entra antes das 15 da tarde, fiquei por 5/6 horas esperando na rua para fazer meu check in,mas tirando isso, fiquei bem e confortável me senti em casa
Lovely room, very close to the centre of town and on the Greenway. Very clean and comfortable. I was welcomed by very friendly and generous hosts. Will definitely be back again! 😄
Fantastic hosts, fantastic accomadation i couldnt have better words for the house or denise and finbar
Lovely place to stay in a quiet rural area. Clean and cozy room with all necessary facilities. Hosts are so friendly and helpful and we got a very warm welcome.
Marie was an excellent host. The room was clean and cozy. The continental breakfast was delicious as well. We enjoyed our stay here very much! Thank you for having us!

Tracy’s AirBnB feels spacious and light and is exactly as advertised. The bed was very comfortable. Spotlessly clean! Tracy kindly stocked the room with tea and coffee, Nespresso maker, electric kettle and some essential dishes, mugs and glasses - nice as you start or end your day - before going out for breakfast or enjoying take-away in the evening. Check in and out couldn’t have been easier. Tracy is fantastic about communicating and was so responsive. Happy to have had the opportunity to visit Barna!
A very comfortable and enjoyable stay

Beautiful place to stay in the Irish countryside. This cottage is a few minutes outside the nearest town so it is ideal to rent a car if you plan to stay here. The hosts were extremely accommodating and kind. Their dogs were just as friendly to us!

Catherine was a lovely host, and went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable. The house is walkable from Ballina centre. It's a room in the home, but Catherine was welcoming and there were plenty of little touches to make my stay that bit nicer. It felt homely but absolutely spotless and everything you needed and more, cannot fault this stay ! Thank you Catherine!
Kitty's Cottage was by far one of the best places I've stayed. highly recommended.
Clean place, comfy bed & easy access to Dublin City.

Teresa and Hugh are a lovely warm couple who were only too happy to assist with my questions re: holiday in Dublin. The breakfast was very generous and the bus to city very convenient.Recommend Holly Cottage to any guests traveling to Dublin.
A beautiful stay by the sea. Kieran and Deirdre's cabin is a perfect place to explore Clonakilty and West Cork.
Michael was a great host, accommodating to our group’s needs and communicated very well. I highly recommended this property for location and comfort.
L’appartement est super : propre et bien équipé. L’emplacement est parfait avec le bus à 5 min. Vous pouvez réserver les yeux fermés. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.
Cannot recommend enough. Sorry Greenes restaurant not open two nights we were there though. Thank you again.

Unsere Erwartungen wurden übertroffen - mega schöne Unterkunft mit super Blick und richtig liebevoll eingerichtet!Super liebe Gastgeber, die uns gute Tipps für die Umgebung gegeben haben.Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden es direkt weiter empfehlen!!

Traveling with 2 small kids and Mairead’s place was perfect for a weekend trip to Dungarvan. Location is great, quiet neighborhood and walkable to town. Easy access to the greenway. Would love to come back!
Excellent

Emer and Paul’s place is ideal for a break away too Clare. Accommodation was perfect, had everything we needed and more and was located within a few minutes drive to so many of Clares local attractions. Emer and Paul were also great hosts and on hand to answer any questions we head. Definitely recommend a visit too there place.
great house great location. love the outdoor seating area.

The views at this location are truly like something out of a movie. By far one of the most peaceful and tranquil places I’ve ever stayed at. Kieran is quick to respond, very helpful at recommending local places, and the breakfast options were phenomenal!! This is definitely a place I’ll be visiting again soon.

Joe's house was fantastic and great location close to the beaches and restaurants and great hill walking. Everything in the house was perfect, comfortable and a real home from home, would highly recommend this property and will definitely use again in the future,

The seclusion of the property, yet its distance from local amenities is perfect. The accommodation is beautifully maintained and well equipped to feel at home instantly. The host has very clear instructions in the property on how to use the various water and heating systems. The property is well suited to visiting the local area and the host has a bountiful knowledge of the area and its attractions.

Great place to stay! Fiona was a great host, super friendly and accommodating and provided lovely refreshments. Location wise the place was ideal, close to the city and sights but cozy and quiet. We would definitely stay here again!🪐🪐

We enjoyed our stay a ton! The location is ideal for walking into town but avoids all the loudness of the nightlife. The beds were comfy and the water pressure in the shower was spectacular. We would definitely stay here again!

Amazing views, close to the beach. Accommodation was spotless clean, had all essential items needed and communication with host was prompt. Will definitely stay again and have already recommended to numerous friends.
Jen's studio is lovely. We like the big window next to the bed with a beautiful view. The location is great and the studio is comfortable for a small family with everything we need.
Lost for words💯..Mary is indeed a Superhost can't fault her on anything. Great communication, accomodation was crystal clean, easy to locate..I had a great time. Exactly what I needed
Beautiful and unforgettable spot!
Lovely quirky cottage in the hills above Ashford

We can’t thank the hosts enough as our GPS malfunctioned and the HOST drove up the road in the rain to get us to ensure we found our way. They went above as an AirBnB host. Such a lovely couple and awesome accommodation. I definitely recommend this location.
Perfect location and v quiet. Georgia’s apt was lovely- modern and spacious. Bunk beds were very practical. My teenage kids loved them! 💙❤️Hope to return next year… thank you Georgia 😎

The house was spotless and the views were amazing. It really felt like a home away from home and I loved that I could light the fire and fuel was provided. It was a very comfortable stay for a family of two adults, a teenager and two young kids.

We had a perfect stay. Quiet and peaceful but still walkable to town. Less than a twenty minute walk to get to the heart of Killarney. Closer restaurants were only a ten minute walk. Perfect location to do the Ring of Kerry and the Dingle Peninsula. Hosts were friendly and helpful. My kids loved the rose garden and chicken.
Had a fabulous few days in Bobbys Cottage. Bernie was a brilliant host. Very helpful... nothing was too much trouble. We will be back.
Great host, super responsive and made everything easy for us
Fabulous place in a great location , the host Pauline is friendly and helpful , would definitely stay again and would recommend it to others, thanks Pauline
Extraordinary castle. So full of history. Friendly staff. Loved the animals and walking the grounds. It was like a fairytale.
Would recommend staying here. The house is lovely and we really enjoyed our stay!

Awesome little cabin in an unbelievable location!
Fantastic stay!
The cabin was surpassingly lovely. We felt right at home, comfortable and safe.It is beyond beautiful and full of thoughtful touches.You will love this beautiful cabin.
We stayed for my dads 50th and it’s even more beautiful than the pictures! We had the best time and Bernie was super responsive and always happy to help!
Mary was very nice and always ready to help us 😊. She gave us great recommendations. The room was very nice and clean.
Padraig was the perfect host. Can not fault our stay perfect from start to finish I will definitely be returning.

We had an amazing stay at Beckett’s. The staff is absolutely amazing and super friendly and always helpful.The rooms are superb and we had a great stay with our family (baby boy and dog).I can only recommend this place when you’re in Dublin. It’s a quick ride into the center or a nice walk down by the river bank.The attached restaurant/bar is also great and the little café has delicious treats and coffee.We would definitely come back and stay again if we’re back to Dublin.Thanks for being so great.

We had a lovely stay in Mallow. Eamonn is a great host, he sent us all the instructions via mobile phone with very detailed videos. The house was spotless and we had everything we needed. The location was perfect for us, 10 minutes by car from the train station and 20 minutes walk from the town centre and Lidl and Tesco. We had a lovely time, thanks Eamonn. Hopefully we’ll see you soon.

We had a really lovely stay and very much enjoyed the cottage. It was cozy and comfortable and had everything we needed. Eva was very proactive and helpful with messages, which meant that checking in and out was very smooth and flexible for us. Thanks for everything.
Terrific location; cozy and elegant space!

Incredible stay! The house is extremely charming, clean and bigger than anticipated! The flower gardens are phenomenal along with the views. This truly does feel like a home away from home, great location for a home base and lovely hosts!

Mary’s place was fabulous. The view from the sitting room is stunning. So beautiful to sit and relax and take it all in.The apartment is very well kitted out and lovely and spacious. Mary left us a selection of delicious home made jams, a variety of bread, fruit and the makings of tea and coffee.We really enjoyed our weekend with Mary. We will definitely recommend her place to family and friends.
Had a great experience!
Beautiful cottage in lovely quiet setting.

Baulärm ab morgens durch schwere Abbrucharbeiten im Nebengrundstück, starke interne Geräusche der Installation durch alle Haushalte dieses Bereiches, rotierende Waschmaschine im Nebenraum um 22 Uhr, keinerlei Platz für die Sachen, die Fläche vor dem Bett ist ca. 160x160 cm anzüglich Türbkattöffnung nach innen, stark überteuert!

10/10 in every aspect. The unique nature of this airbnb sets it apart from the rest. Pulling pints never gets old when you're with friends or family. A short journey from Kilarney and Dingle, local minibus services available and with Inch strand only 10 minutes down the road, make this place the perfect place to stay if you're visiting this part of Ireland with a group of family or friends. Can't recommend highly enough. Host's detailed instructions make everything about the airbnb process pain free.

Bernadette saved me in my time of need! The night after staying in an unsafe airbnb in the center of Dublin, I moved to Bernadette’s beautiful home. Everything was perfect. Her home is a palace. The room is small but perfectly set up for a stay. I flew out the next morning from the very close airport. Bernadette communicates very well! Her home was the most modern I stayed at in a week in Ireland. Wonderful hot shower. Comfortable bed. Quiet neighborhood. What more could you ask for? Perfect. Five stars.

Tutto perfetto. La casa e’ veramente molto piacevole. Pulitissima, luminosa, ben accessoriata e con una bellissima vista. Aislinn è molto carina e molto disponibile. Siamo stati benissimo e ci torneremmo molto volentieri. Grazie di tutto Aislinn!
Our stay was an absolute treat, in a dream of a cottage, aided by helpful and patient hosts. we loved the charm, the homey feel of the place and the luxury of the hot tub and sun room.
Second time I stay at Grace’s. As always everything perfect.
Un endroit magnifique et attachant.Des hôtes très sympathiques.Top

The hosts were great and the location was just what we were looking for. It was incredibly accessible and easy to find. The space was tidy and had the basics anyone could need. The hosts were responsive to my numerous questions and very friendly.

Mijn dochter logeerde 4 maanden in een kamer in de woning van Tim. Zij deelde de badkamer met een andere gast en de keuken met iedereen. Er waren duidelijke afspraken en alles verliep zeer vlotjes. Het huis was steeds zeer netjes. Tijdens het spitsuur geraak je met de bus rechtstreeks in Dublin centrum op 40-60 min. Buiten de spits doe je er 25 min. over. De bushalte is ongeveer 5 tot 10 min stappen van de woning.
Bon emplacement, logement plutôt grand et bien aménagé. Instructions claires. Prix excessif comme beaucoup de logements à Dublin.
One of the nicest Airbnb I have stayed in since working in Cork, absolutely faultless. so much so I left a bottle of wine to say thank you to The host.
Amazing views & lovely local beach for swimming. Living area was great for a big group! Would highly recommend!
Excellent endroit idyllique en pleine nature. Magnifique région et cottage superbe

If you plan to rely on wifi, I will say we did have infrequent issues with getting signal in our tent. Dave and David were wonderful and helped us with recommendations! Really enjoyed having this as our home base while in Doolin.
Will is a great host,the tiny house was spotless and equipped with all you could need. And only a two min drive from a spectacular beach. Would love to stay there again sometime.
Great farm stay! Loved the scenery; farm and friendly animals, fresh produce from garden; amazing baked goods and chats with Barbara.
Modern clean house.Friendly welcome.Recommended.

Really enjoyed my two weeks here. The apartment is very well equipped & is very comfortable. There is a total feeling of privacy even though the apartment is an extension to the main house. Terry is an absolute gentleman who is there if you need to call on him. Really enjoyed the day trips to Kylemore Abbey & Inishbofin island. Perfect location & I loved every minute of my time in lovely Renvyle.Thank you Terry.

Lovely stay in the apartments just off the top of Eyre Square. Perfectly central and easy access to everything. Apartments are easy to get to and the view was outstanding!Had everything you could want, bathrooms and bedrooms were spotless. Beds were comfy and there was tonnes of storage space. Only critique is the very high security deposit and the damages already in the apartments, however I understand the need for the deposit.

Stunning accommodation in lovely quiet location. Dympna was a fabulous host, any questions I had she answered them all, great communication.Beautiful, comfortable, cosy accommodation, like being at home almost, the decor is stunning. Highly recommend to all *****. Would definitely return to stay in gorgeous place 😊

We had such a wonderful two night stay with our children 6&8. They had great fun collecting eggs from the hens in the morning. The house is amazing, very comfortable and spacious. It has everything you would need for your stay and the view from the front of the house is breathtaking. Geraldine is a very accommodating and attentive host, I would highly recommend a stay here.
Amazing place, definitely in the countryside, but close enough to Westport, Amazing views and location. Highly recommend!
This is a lovely and we'll kelp place

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay with Tomas and Sally. I found Sentio to be so peaceful, whilst not too remote. The accommodation is spotlessly clean and very well presented with lots of little local touches. This is a place that I would happily return to equally for Sally and Tomas's hospitality and for all the wonderful attractions locally

This B&B was exactly as described and it was everything we hoped for. Rose was very responsive and her parents were very helpful with our checkin. We enjoyed the couple of days that we stayed at this charming cottage and definitely will keep this in mind when our travel brings us back to Ireland.
Ein schönes cottage in Toller Lage. Wir haben uns wohlgefühlt! 😊
Séjour très agréable. Jennie est attentive à ce que tout soit parfait .

Anne’s place was magical. Within a three night stay, our cares melted away, our minds and bodies were at rest and it inspired creativity…the view from the kitchen is very paintable and poetic. We were warm, cosy and relaxed. Anne was very helpful with check in and recommendations as to what to do nearby. You do need a car for access to both the cottage and nearby Dingle. This place fills you up and I was sad to leave but look forward to staying again. The interior is very private and if you want a bit of peace from your fellow travellers, there are plenty of doors to close, so their chatter doesn’t disturb you. Groceries are in Dingle and there are many scenic walks such as the Kerry Camino and the Dingle Way and drives, with even a castle nearby. Simply idyllic!
Great room in a great place. Would recommend highly!
Hannah is a very kind and friendly host and she made us a delicious breakfast! The house is nice and the room spacious and in a lovely place in natureHighly recommend staying at her place

Staying with Cathy and Kate was such a joy! Their hospitality and care were unparalleled. My favorite part of the stay was getting out for a 6 mile jog with Cathy who showed me some of the sites from a local's perspective.

It‘s an awesome location and a really luxiours room with an amazing bayhroom!The hosts are both absolutly amazing and will answer every question you like! An addition they serve you an brlliant breakfast menu!Make sure to visit the nearby Silver Leauge.
Excellent location for a weekend getaway. A well maintained, bright and quiet house.Within walking distance of Clonakilty.Eabha & Hetty were very welcoming aswell.Highly recommended!

The room was very cozy and carefully equipped - it was to see that Gerard really made an effort. We felt welcome right from the start as Gerard was very friendly and funny. The place has a good position to go on daytrips around Kerry (Ring of Kerry, Skellig, Valentia Islands etc.), however only with a car.

Bisher für mich die schlechteste Airbnb-Erfahrung. Wozu ein zusätzliches Online-Checkin, was dann nicht funktioniert? Keine Reaktion auf Fragen dazu. Es gab nicht einmal Handseife und nach Handtüchern musste man erst fragen. Die Rezeption war bemüht, aber unterbesetzt, was zu langen Wartezeiten beim Checkin vor Ort führt. Das hat uns einige Nerven und Urlaubszeit gekostet. Lediglich die zentrale Lage war positiv.
The apartment is less than 30 minutes walk from the city center, in a quiet place. Zoe was an amazingly generous host! 🙏
We had a fantastic time at the Fisherman’s Village. Great location on the Wild Atlantic Way with wonderful hosts and an amazing breakfast each morning. We will definitely be back!

Wow. This is a lovely little place, beautifully decorated, good location within Dublin (15-20 min walk to centre) and the host Tom is a really nice guy; polite and cool. If your looking for a place to stay, I would definitely recommend here. Me and my girlfriend really enjoyed our stay and felt very welcomed.
Excellent location, perfect acces to the city. Close to high quality shopping centre. Useful for visiting surroundings counties Wicklow, Kilkenny etc.
A lovely location to relax and enjoy being surrounded by nature in a comfortable and modern cabin with everything we needed. Thanks for looking after us and the dogs with some tasty treats too.

I’ll just be yet another voice in the chorus of happy travelers to echo how much of a hidden gem this location truly is. Stocked with goodies, located right off the water with beautiful views, adjacent to excellent restaurants and topping it all off was our morning feline visitor purring up a cute little send-off while chatting with the owner. Just a wonderful experience all around. Would recommend this spot to absolutely anyone and everyone.

Wir haben uns während unseres Aufenthalts in Dublin sehr wohl bei Brendan und Eric gefühlt. Die Wohnung der beiden liegt super Zentral. Perfekt für ein verlängertes Wochenende. Brendan gab uns ein paar tolle Tipps zum essen gehen. Wir hatten eine super Zeit.
Julia was very kind and helpful and her home is in a very convenient location.
Simply the retreat everyone drserves. Anne set the cottage up in such a warm welcoming way. Beautiful.
Lovely modern and clean space. Very comfortable beds. Super location and minutes walk from Galway city. Great base to explore Connemara and more

Great for access to airport, clean and shower facilities. Parked my car there for the week I was away. Bus it really easy use. Taxi was 24€ at 2am in the morning. This is a self contain unit in the house so it was really worth it.

Thanks Niall for hosting us. We all enjoyed our stay, including 4 kids! The house was clean and as described and we enjoyed a lovely welcome pack of tea/coffee and treats on arrival.Theres so much to do in Banagher and surrounding areas so we would definitely recommend a stay in your house as a base and close to everything.

Jose ist ein super Gastgeber. Er war immer gut erreichbar und hat schnell geantwortet. Wir hatten Glück und das andere Zimmer war nur zeitweise belegt.Wenn man sich läger in der Wohnung aufhalten möchte und beide Zimmer belegt sind könnte es vielleicht etwas eng werden.
Great place!

Agnes ist eine sehr warmherzige und unglaublich freundliche Frau. Ihr macht es sehr viel Spaß, die Gäste aufzunehmen und zu betreuen. Es ist ihr wichtig, dass man sich bei ihr wohlfühlt. Sie hat gute Empfehlungen für Kilkenny, wo man hingehen kann. Das Zimmer war sehr sauber, das Bett sehr komfortabel und das Frühstück war reichlich und lecker.
Had a great time during our stay. Fantastic quiet location close to everything you’d want to do!
check-in and stay without problems. it was quiet and private. the apartment has everything we needed. the center of Killarney is not far away. just a few minutes walk. I recommend. 😊

My stay here was absolutely the worstI had booked in the evening but when I got there I had not received a code for the room and the host did not respond so I had to leave , I then gave them the benefit of the doubt to rebook the next morning instead of a refund when we got there the room was smaller than described , the cleaners had not cleaned the room and there was a broken sink that had to be fixed and the host did not even bother to mention these factors even though he knew it was an early check in , the room was much smaller than advertised and we thought he had made a mistake as the room opposite was the size it was shown online, when he called to say we are in the wrong room he immediately started swearing on the phone and shouting over when we were talking calmly trying to explain at the start the service was horrible then the room was not as described and he continued to scream on the phone to get out DO NOT RECOMMEND!
Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour ici. Les hôtes et la maison sont très accueillants.
Un accueil parfait c'est pour moi un sans faute.

Mike’s house was in a stunning location, nice private & extremely spacious. It matched the description. It’s an ideal location for people looking to do the Bridle Beara way, walking or horseback. It’s very close to a lovely busy pub which had a chipper wagon on site. Mike was extremely helpful during our stay.

The house was unique and in a great location in relation to Kenmare (the friendly Sheep dog and her pups across the way made it really fun) but overall for the price, there were some basic things that could be upgraded / added to make the stay better. TV didn't work initially and even after the host showed up to fix it, only one channel would come up -- a minor concern overall, as it was just something to do when we were back from being out and about. Bigger issue was the lack of any type of sponges or drying rack for dishes, making doing a dishes a nightmare in a place without a dishwasher. This comes off as just kinda cheap, something also reflected by lack of towels, shampoo and soap in the bathrooms, no small shelves the bathrooms for your own items and really sketchy showers that were either crazy hot or crazy cold with awful pressure. Side and coffee table were the collapsible ones you get at IKEA on the way out. Just a small amount of expenditure could make this place great.

Well if I could give Glashnacree Coach House a 10* rating I would ,from the moment you drive through the gates ,the house & gardens will take your breath away! Greg was so kind & welcoming ,the attention to detail in the Coach House was amazing ,everything & more .It really is the most beautiful location in Kerry ,wonderful views with a serene atmosphere .You will leave totally refreshed & blissed out ! Thank you Greg
Camp de base parfait pour visiter le Clare. À 30 mn des attractions principales. Logement parfaitet hôte accueillante et agréable.
Really enjoyed our stay loved the hot tub loved everything about it
Geeatl use of space place, beautifully decorated, bright and airy. Great location for the beach and all the local attractions.

If you are looking for a dreamy location and a dreamy castle stay, look no further! Once in a lifetime experience for sure. The hosts were lovely and the location was simply perfect. An Ireland oasis!Full transparency is that, as the listing says, it is a castle - and it is a old and damp. Anyone with allergies might have some issues. Neither of these things ruined our stay, it just made things a little inconvenient.We booked for the castle experience and were not disappointed. Thank you for the hard work to restore this castle and put it to good use.

Julia and Yuri were lovely, welcoming hosts that opened the door with a smile :)Lovely, immaculate room that was super comfortable and nicely separated from the rest of the house up the spiral staircase.Would highly recommend!
Loved our few days in our pod! Immaculate and great size. Close to everything. Thanks William!

We loved our stay in Adare. Lil’s place was the perfect home base for exploring the area. Everything was comfortable and cozy. She even left us some games for our five year old, which he loved. Beds were comfortable. Extra blankets were appreciated. Overall, a lovely stay.
Great little spot to stay while visiting Dublin. Peters place is very close to all amenities and transportation. Grand spot!!
Barry indeed is a great host. The place is in peaceful neighbourhood. Well maintained. I would certainly love to visit same place in future. I recommend this place with highest ratings
Marianne is a wonderful host. She is very kind and communicates instantly. I feel as I am at home. Everything is perfect inside the house.
Beautiful Grounds and the pool was beautiful at sunset. the accommodation was perfect and private and clean
Enjoyed my stay! Good location wi thin walking distance of everything in Rosslare.
We enjoyed our stay at Tanya’s. The area was very quiet and there was a few different food options near by. It was easy to complete the self checkin with Tanya’s clear instructions.
Great place in a magical location, it is located in the Black Valley surrounded by mountains. Perfect for anyone wanting to enjoy nature. Very clean and comfortable. Amazing views. Lovely pets.
Host were super welcoming and accommodating. Great location near the centre of town.
Excellent stay. Clean, easy to find, warm, cosy and comfortable. Very close to Ballyjamesduff and ample parking. Check in was seamless. Will be back.

Beautiful, clean, safe room in a shared house just 20 minutes from Dublin's city center. Super easy to get into town with the bus (10 min walk to the stop). Cool, hip neighborhood with yummy restaurants and cafes nearby for a different taste of Dublin. Sarah was super sweet, communicative and easy to work with. The room was tasteful, cozy, and had the best bed! Would absolutely return again.

We had a lovely few days in the red cottage, which is situated in idyllic surroundings. Mairead was a super host, very responsive & treated us to some delicious home made bread, scones & jam, a really lovely touch.

Kelly und ihre Familie waren super liebe Gastgeber, die tolle Tipps für unsere weitere Irlandreise hatten.Sie haben haben uns ihre traumhafte Umgebung gezeigt und wir durften an ihrem Pferdealltag teilhaben :) Danke für den spontanen, tollen Aufenthalt bei euch und eure offene und unkomplizierte Art!
Lovely Airbnb. Comfortable beds. Clean and homely living area. Easy check-in and parking and easy well-lit 15 minute walk down the town. Host was very helpful. Would stay again.

Our stay at Coyne's cottage was fantastic. Ceara and Kevin were so welcoming and helpful - the perfect hosts. The cottage was sweet: very comfortable and had everything we needed. And such a beautiful setting in the hills, looking down over the lake. We particularly enjoyed sitting in the garden and returning the friendly waves of the local farmers as they drove past in their tractors and watching the sheepdogs working in the fields opposite. We also spent some lovely evenings walking and fishing in Lough Mask. We leave with some very fond memories.
Perfect location to walk to all of the pubs and restaurants. Anna is very friendly and responsive. Would recommend.
Great place! Lots of character with a great host.
Great place to stay and very relaxing. I really enjoyed my quiet stay here. If I’m ever back in the area I’ll make sure this is where I’ll be.
Justin’s home is absolutely beautiful. The home is very spacious and super clean! The view is unreal and one of the best airbnbs we have stayed at. We would love to stay here again!
Very cosy, romantic place!

My family of five had a great stay at Phil’s on the Dingle Peninsula. The house was just as the pictures showed it would be and Phil was an excellent and very responsive host. We were surprised at how quiet the surrounding area was and how great the views were, both from inside the house and standing out in the front. The location was absolutely perfect for exploring the Dingle peninsula. It was no more than a ten minute drive to Dingle with fantastic pubs, shops, and atmosphere. There is a great little pub called Paidi O Se about a two minute drive from the house that I highly recommend for an evening dinner and a pint. We also took the Eco Marine tour right from Ventry and had an amazing time. If we could do it all over, we wouldn’t change a thing about the whole experience.

lovely house. location is perfect for solitude. Mary is a lovely lady. House is close to the beach. The walks are beautiful. My advice is to bring food as places to eat are limited. Furniture in the main sitting is old and not so comfortable. If your looking for some peace and quiet, then look no further as this Gem is a rare find. I would return every year. Mary made sure everything was just perfect.
Great deal the host was very friendly and helpful. Cozy room great for two people and a 5 minute walk from a train line directly to downtown Dublin. Great for travellers on a budget.
We had a blowout on the way to our Rental unit. Cormac called a local towing company / tire repair company to assist us, and our rental vehicle’s tire was immediately replaced. Outstanding help.
Imelda was a great host, very helpful and they have a great view from their property.

The apartment was in a great location and well within walking distance to everything! The hosts was very quick at responding and provided excellent recommendations for places to eat and things to do. They also checked in part way through the visit to make sure we had everything we needed. The apartment is really designed for 2 people-4 might be crowded. The apartment can furnished including a full kitchen and washer/dryer.
Beautiful house, beautiful location - we had one night stay only for a wedding but would live to come back!
Our family of four had a lovely one night stay. Peaceful surroundings and cozy cottage. Would highly recommend. Hosts were welcoming and lovely.

Mary's place was excellent. Mary gave us a very friendly greeting. Her place had every amenity,with extra touches like, high viz jackets and torches. The accommodation was of a very high standard. The area was so beautiful, with great walks and views. Mary's place also has a beautiful garden. Old, blended with modern landscaping.

A true gem in the most beautiful surroundings. The warmest of welcomes and the most perfect accommodation. Pristine and full of character. Secluded bay on your doorstep and a lovely private garden at the rear. Olivia and Andrew couldn't do enough for us and Archie is just adorable. Well worth a visit. We will definately be returning.
Perfect spot for a big group, very central and great all round.

Marina was the perfect host the cottage was so comfortable and warm, marina had scones with jam and butter for us on arrival which was a lovely gesture, she had the fire set for us and turf which we lite and was so homly,Thankyou Marina again would definitly recommend your cottageRegards Olivia
Beautiful house in a beautiful location. Highly recommended!
Highly recommend. Very clean and tidy, ideal location and very friendly owners. We will stay again.

Anyone would be lucky to stay in this gorgeous house. It was so warm and absolutely spotless. Everything you’d need is here, bread , milk, butter to name but a few was supplied. We will definitely be back.

Awesome stay! The Annex of Helen is so beautiful and cozy, we would definitly stay longer if we could. Helen is a wonderful host! She is so nice and helped us with a lot of Tipps around the area! For hiking and exploring the wonderful connemara and crough Patrick Region it is an excellent spot! We were in Ireland during march and it was totally okay with the Temperature! Annex is warm and you have the possibilty to make tea. Breakfast at Helens house is also an absolute plus! You should stay here!
Spent two nights in Andy's house as a group. Spacious house with all home comforts.
Freeda's place was exactly what we were looking for. Peaceful and relaxing with amazing views. Very friendly.

Charmant endroit, perdu au milieu de la campagne irlandaise et pourtant à 10 minutes de Kenmare et ses facilités.L'endroit est joliment décoré, bien équipé. Nick est un hôte à la fois discret et totalement disponible.
tutto perfetto!!

The OG Airbnb experience at best. Andrei and Nadia are great people. They greeted us so warmly and gave us local recommendations that you cannot find on lonely planet. Thank you, Andrei and Nadia, for making the Ireland trip so special.

Pauline’s place was great! there were 5 of us and we all felt comfortable in her house. She had a delicious apple pie and fresh bread waiting for us which was great. Plenty of rooms for a comfortable stay. Place is around 25 minutes from downtown. We loved our stay and highly recommend it for a large group and for a family with kids.
came to Kilkenny for one night for a wedding, this was ideal for our needs, simple clean great location, just what you want
It was really great staying at Endas. it was a small walk from town and a really peaceful place.
Beautiful view! Wish I could have stayed longer. But felt very comfortable staying the time that I did!
A great getaway and a beautiful cabin
Pleasant cottage to stay for exploring the environment and hiking the gorgeous trails of Kerry. Nice and quiet location to disconnect and relax.
Due to no fault of Emma’s, we had to cancel our stay.

Emma was very welcoming, and it's a lovely room, comfortable and with little homely touches. Good shower. Coffe/tea making facilities in the room. Secure parking for my motorcycle right outside the house - fellow bikers be aware the lane is gravel with grass growing in the middle, but I had no problems getting in and out. Thank you for a lovely stay!
THX

Noreen is a great host, she know a tremendous amount of local information, this would make a great booklet in the accommodation. She was on hand for anything we needed. It is a lovely quiet stot thank you Noreen.

Mary is a fantastic host. Her house is really a home and provides the opportunity to relax and rejuvenate somewhere you can feel comfortable. Sinead's place was exactly what we needed in a lovely location with lovely views. it had everything we needed so would highly recommend!!
Nos ha encantado el lugar pero sin lugar a duda lo mas destacable ha sido la amabilidad de su anfitrion a quien estamos muy agradecidos.
Great spot would recommend for any quite weekend away, Thanks to Mark for hosting us!

The apartment was very clean, bigger than expected and in a really central location but still quiet. Stephen was very helpful and quick to respond. We would definitely stay here again.
logement et chambre très confortable ! nous avons passé une très bonne nuit de sommeil !

This is a great place for two people. We received a warm welcome and hospitality from Colm and Catherine. The apartment is close to the Gap of Dunloe and Black Valley, which we cycled from the house. Great location for exploring the Wicklow mountains and surrounding areas. Felt very private and peaceful. Crystal's recommendations were ideal, we had a wonderful time - many thanks!
Elizabeth was a fabulous host, the house was ideal, clean, close to amenities and perfect for our stay.

Perfect place to stay while in Galway. Pam and Tony are wonderful hosts! Their BnB is lovely, comfortable, just as described in the listing. It’s a very short walk to shopping, restaurants, and pubs. Lovely stay at Andrew's place, super convenient location, walkable to everywhere in kilkenny city. Andrew was super accomodating and lovely.
Lovely cosy house in great location. Spotlessly clean and exactly as advertised.

This spot made our trip!! It was the cutest place and so homey! Definitely recommend.

Fantastic location for restaurants, pubs, and pedestrian areas. If you arrive at nigh, look for the pink door as the building numbers do not seem to be consecutive. We found the artwork and decor tasteful and the mattress comfortable. Although very walkable, it was still quiet at night.

Location is perfect to seeDublin and walk just about everywhere. Even tours we took stated from walkable locations. Would recommend this location to anyone looking to stay central and walk around. I'd stay here again!
We really enjoyed our stay! The home is exactly as pictured. We walked to the beach each day and really enjoyed Clare’s local recommendations!
A very nice and quiet setting with a very spacious and nicely set up accomodation. Close to many local historical landmarks. We really enjoyed our stay.
Great location, walking distance to both city centre and Salthill. Clean and not cluttered. Easy, free parking. Art was very responsive. Would definitely be back if in Galway again.
Lovely house, a short stroll from Doolin village. Ideal for exploring Clare and the neighbouring counties. Loraine was a very responsive host and check in was seamless.

Logement propre et confortable, facile d'accès et a 10min du train, proche des arrêts de bus. le logement etait conforme à la description. Really convenient location near DART and local restaurants in monkstown and Dún Laoghaire. The gastropub next door was brilliant, and great with our kids. Recommend that’s amore restaurant in monkstown, 5 mins walk away for the BEST seafood pasta.

The apartment was spacious, clean, and overall lovely. It was in the perfect location to explore the city. It was also amazing to have all the cooking appliances and supplies we needed, as well as Netflix on the TV. We really enjoyed our stay!

This place is an absolute gem. You will not be disappointed. Pristine clean, cosy, stylish and unique interior. Super host with excellent attention to detail. Stunning nature surrounding you. You really couldn’t ask for more.
Excellent time. We had lots of fun. The place is very charming. The kids were feeding donkeys and collect eggs from the farm. Such a great family time.
