Fantastic value, beautiful house, great showers and helpful host!

This was such a lovely holiday and we loved having a home base at Kennedy’s Cottage. It was charming and quaint and not far from anything. We could easily get to all of the main attractions (Cliffs of Moher, Ring of Kerry, Galway, Cork etc). The donkey and mini horse made our mornings. Would stay again in a heartbeat.

We stayed just one night at this beautiful property and loved our stay in the castle. One of our favorite places we stayed on our vacation, wish we could have stayed more than one night. Plenty of space, nice rooms with comfortable beds.
Great place to stay
Wonderful experience! Unique scenes - especially beautiful with the river at night. Will definitely recommend to friends & family :))
Sam's place was just what we needed. We loved the wee touches, like the parking discs, pukka tea, water bottles, etc.

It was an ideal place to stay for us after a day walking Sliabh league. Very easy self check in, a nice hot shower, fanstastic tv in a lovely private space. Great touches in the air bnb by the host. Only a short drive to killybegs for dinner, with options of takeaway aswell!

Spent an amazing two nights at Glendalough Glamping. Definitely felt like I was glamping. Such a nice experience to sleep and wake up in nature in the pod but have the luxury of a well equipped clean kitchen/bathroom facilities. Super accessible with the bus stop to Dublin just down the road. Glendalough itself is about 45min walk away. We will be coming back without a doubt.

Mary is a very friendly and fantastic host. She gave us great restaurant recommendations, told us about the best things to do in the area, and also made us feel very at home with a great breakfast.We also enjoyed chatting with her about the history of the area, seeing her historic Irish postcard collection, and just chatting about life in general.Oh, and the dog is cute too!

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour de 3 nuits en famille dans ce super logement. De très bons équipements, très bien agencé, une très bonne literie,... Et merci à Geraldine qui a été très accueillante et nous a donné d'excellents conseils pour visiter les magnifiques alentours. Nous recommandons vivement !
Had a perfect stay! Thank you!

We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful barn renovation. A great place to retreat to and switch off. Very warm, comfortable beds and immaculately clean. Fully equipped kitchen and social space to dine and chat. Lovely host to deal with.

The location was perfect.The room was clean and cozy especially for solo traveler.More than that,Sadia & Dee were very helpful with quick response!It was a big relief for solo traveler in the city never been before.
Very clean,comfortable and modern apartment. Convenient location for all activities. Bikes an added bonus
Great place. Super for peace & quiet. Nice touches - fresh scones & unreal jam + The bench at the top of the meadow for “sundowners”!
Stayed in Mickey Cottage such a beautiful homely experience. The cottage is well equipped and clean. I would recommend this cottage for a tranquil stay.

Joans house had everything!! The house was so clean and perfect. Joan made me feel right at home. Even had shaving foam in the bathroom. She is vary helpful and would stop what she is doing and would chat away to you. Great stay 👍
Great scenery, quiet location somewhat remote while easy reachable if you have transport organized (bike / car)
A nice central located spacious apartment
Muiris a été très accueillante. elle nous a donné des renseignements sur les restaurantset activités à découvrir alentours.nous avons passé un bon séjour

Perfect homely cottage in a perfect location to explore and enjoy Achill Island. Beach is a few minutes walk one way and restaurant/cafe/pub are under a minute's walk the other way. The house was immaculate and spotless and we were treated to freshly made scones waiting for us on our arrival. Would highly recommend the house to anyone visiting Achill Island. You won't be disappointed.

This was my second time staying with Paula and I would highly recommend. The room now has a double bed and TV with guest access to Netflix. It is definitely a home away from home & unbelievably clean 😊
Excellent Place to start outdoor activities in Connemara National Park. We had a great stay!
Appartement très bien placé, propre et neuf. Il manquait cependant quelques équipement de cuisine, une table et des chaises pour apprécier un bon repas maison.

Wir haben jede Minute auf Tory Island genossen! Treasas Unterkunft ist ruhig gelegen, mit einer phantastischen Aussicht auf das Meer und nur wenige Minuten entfernt von den Klippen. Es war alles da, was man so braucht, sogar kostenloses Trinkwasser - das Haus selbst ist etwas kalt, durch die zur Verfügung gestellten Heizstrahler wurde es aber sehr gemütlich. Als unsere Fähre am Abreisetag gecancelt wurde, hat uns Liam selbst zurück ans Festland gefahren! Wir freuen uns schon auf unseren nächsten Besuch! (:
Very convenient as a stop over after getting off the ferry. Host met us at the property, and was helpful. Clean & comfortable .

Loved our stay, everything that was described about the cottage was stop on.Great location and loved the garden. What the pictures show is very accurate. Host was very informative and booking in was easy and accessible. Had a wonderful time, only wish it was longer but I am sure we shall return and spend a long weekend. Thank you for the wonderful stay.

I couldn’t recommend our stay in Heidi’s pristine house more . I was there with my 74 year old parents and my four year old child - and the house was perfect for both. It was spotlessly clean on arrival and the house has every appliance and gadget you could ever need. The location is excellent - slightly back from the main road of Rosses’ Point but less than a five minute drive to the beach , cafe etc . Heidi was incredibly warm and easy to communicate with and it is clear she really wishes her guests to enjoy their stay. We will definitely be returning , it was such a restful and relaxing stay . Thank you Heidi.
Three things are wonderful: the house on the sea, the walk to the Cliffs of Moher, and the kindness of Martina and her family. As Martina writes it is recommended to come by car.

It was a beautiful home inside and out! The beds were comfortable, and we appreciated the tea and coffee in the rooms. The only small problem we had was that it was a bit cool in the morning and there was no way to increase the heat. We were there in late September. But overall, we were extremely satisfied, and I would enjoy staying with Siobhan again!

Marie and Brenda were exceptional hosts: welcoming, friendly, very generous and good communicators. The cottage was cosy yet spacious, and spotlessly clean. Facilities were excellent and the cottage lacked nothing. There was a wide array of local and homemade foodstuffs prepared for us - all delicious, which contributed to making this a most memorable stay.

Room and bathroom (across the room) are clean. Hubby and I had a comfy stay. Their dog is the cutest. Glenda is very nice and hospitable. House is located in a very safe environment, but a bit far from Dublin/Center. Overall nice and good stay. Highly recommended!
Absolutely brilliant house…great location, spotless and has everything and more that’s needed…Liz was always quick to respond to any questions, already planning the next trip!

Our stay at Mayfly Lodge was fantastic! Emelyn was incredibly friendly and helpful, ensuring we had everything we needed throughout our visit. The lodge can easily accommodate a family of four, is spotlessly clean, and well-equipped with all the amenities we required. We especially enjoyed the wonderful views on Lough Derg and the hike onto Moylussa. Overall, a highly recommendable place for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.
Great accommodation, great host and so handy to CAHIR , Cork and limerick. Bed was super comfortable and kitchen was well stocked with essentials!
It was nice and spacious. Eddie was kind enough to warm it up ahead of time for us. We will definitely be coming back if we’re looking for a place to stay around Galway.
Really lovely house in a beautiful part of the world ,we hope to get back there again
Our stay at Ita's place was a dream! Can not wait to come back here again with my family :)
Very comfortable and spotless clean
Lovely B&B
Possibly one of the most stocked Airbnb’s I’ve ever stayed at. Anita and John were amazing! Beds were heaven! You should book this Airbnb!
Lovely stay with Donna, super close to Buncrana and North West Golf Club. Room was large and very clean. Thanks so much for a great stay

Rory und seine Frau sind sehr liebenswerte Menschen, die sehr gut für uns gesorgt haben. Alles war perfekt, das Frühstück war toll und der abendliche Tee war auch sehr lecker. Mit ihrem Hund Oscar hatten wir viel Spaß. Wir können die Unterkunft nur weiter empfehlen. Die Lage ist perfekt für schöne Ausflüge, da der Wohnort am Ring of Kerry liegt. Rory hat uns gute Tipps gegeben. Vielen Dank für alles.

This place was amazing! Very new and modern with a great view. Irene and her family were very kind and helpful. They can recommend anything you like from bars to restaurants and even make arrangements with the local establishments for your visit. I can not thank Irene and her family enough for their hospitality and kindness.
Fantastic setting and very relaxing. Pods and kitchen area was absolutely perfect for our stay. Would highly recommend , we will be back.

Booked this air bnb for 5 nights. It was easy to find and had parking for a very reasonable price. We had 4 people and it had enough room. The listing says washer and dryer but we only had a washer. Our first day the shower wasn’t working, we called and someone came promptly and fixed the issue. Second day the toilet wasn’t flushing, we called again, and again someone came very quickly and fixed the issue. One night we couldn’t figure out the heat and someone came within minutes and had it turned on for us. These issues didn’t impact our time as we were met with friendly and prompt service. It was about a 15 min walk to temple bar, directly across the street is a super market, fast food, coffee etc, which made quick stops easy and convenient. Over all we were happy with our booking and enjoyed our time in Dublin. Thanks for hosting us !Dimitra & Adam
Kellies Apartment has all one needs for a very comfy stay within 5 mins walk to town.
Great place near the middle of the city!! Enjoyed our stay!!

We had a fantastic stay in the cabin. Gorgeous views and comfortable accommodation. Close to the town too. The hosts were easy to deal with and quick to answer any queries we had. Would love to go back!

We had a lovely stay in Jenny’s house; there was plenty of room for both families; it worked well having two bedrooms upstairs and two downstairs. Having lots of bathrooms was great - especially as there were plenty of watersports on the go.Dunfanaghy is a lovely spot; I’d highly recommend a trip to ards forest park, marble hill beach and a little further away - Glenveagh castle.
Stunning location. Everything was as described. Didn't manage to meet the hosts but the dogs were wonderful hosts who greeted us regularly and made the stay very special.

We had a wonderful stay in the cottage - it is even more charming in person! Rooms full of character and v spacious, and it has brilliant views out the front. Donal was a lovely host and very helpful. We really appreciated the little extra touches - had left for us homemade scones and some jam, fresh farm eggs, etc. Couldn’t fault it!

The place was easy to find, within the town with restaurants, grocery stores and shops at walkable distance. The house was beautiful, neat, comfortable and all amenities were well maintained. The host is quick to respond and helpful. Thanks to Lisa for the wonderful experience.

Sandhills house is just perfect. Nuala the host couldn’t have been more helpful. Always prompt in answering my queries and extremely helpful with ideas. Our stay was wonderful. A great location allowing us to attend a wedding locally and explore a little of the Atlantic way. We were able to enjoy early morning walks or an evening stroll along the beach. Just stunning. Sandhills house had everything we needed. My daughters even set out to find something that wasn’t there. They failed. Fantastic.Would thoroughly recommend although I would love to keep this little gem to myself!!

It's rare to find an airbnb that's better than the pictures, but this home exceeded our expectations. The property is beautiful, in an idyllic Irish countryside setting. It felt like we were in a movie set, with gorgeous green meadows, the blue lake and sheep, quiet surroundings, and a large home that is completely comfortable. The views out of every window were like paintings. The rooms are large and spacious, with nice beds and bedding for all. It was cosy and warm on the cold days when the weather was stormy, and the showers always had nice hot water. The kitchen is fully equipped and comfortably large, and wifi in every room made working here easy. Our family loved hiking the surrounding hills, playing at the lake, and even practicing tennis. The hosts are lovely people, always willing to help, and very responsive. We feel so fortunate to have found this place!! It was a perfect home base as we worked from here and then trekked out on day trips around Ireland. Thank you!

Lovely apartment in a wonderful and very secure building, tastefully decorated, with all the amenities desired and immaculately clean. Minded by a lovely team headed by Karin who was always at hand in case we needed help.Centrally located and well serviced by public transport.GREAT STAY!
Great place, everything is as seen.
This loft apartment was in a great location to enjoy downtown Kenmare. Our space was clean, comfortable and inviting. Don't miss out on the Rookery Breakfast, it was so good!!
We had a great stay at the cabin. Our hosts were very helpful and hospitable throughout our stay and we would highly recommend a stay here.
This place was AMAZING! Great location, great space for a larger group. Prime location and very comfortable. We were bummed we couldn’t stay for longer. Highly recommended for a stay in Kilkenny.
Lovely room, clean and convenient, very happy with our stay

Lovely house, plenty of space, pretty garden. Easy to get to from the airport and for Croke Park. A bit further to the city centre (we took a taxi) but pubs/shops locally too. Tara was brilliant, really helpful and responsive.

Wir hatten eine wunderschöne Zeit in dem kleinen Cottage. Es ist gemütlich eingerichtet und es hat alles, was man braucht. Rose war so lieb und hat Kaffee & Milch, sowie Brot und ein paar Snacks bereitgestellt :) wir haben uns wie zu Hause gefühlt und von der Unterkunft aus konnte man perfekt den Ring of Kerry, das Gap of Dunloe und Killarney entdecken. Wir haben die Zeit dort sehr genossen und können es jedem empfehlen :)
Great stay! Our room was very clean, we had a ton of space, and the staff was very friendly and helpful!

This is a great apartment, really big, spotlessly clean, great location right in the centre of town, you can hear the music from the pub next door but is doesn't go on too late, didn't bother us at all
La habitación están dentro de la casa familiar del anfitrión. Damien fue muy amable y servicial. La estancia y el baño eran amplios y estaban muy limpios. Recomendable!
What a beautiful and peaceful place to stay! Within walking distance to town with spectacular views of the Cliffs of Moher. Hope to return in the future.
Nous avons passé un agréable séjour chez Mary. Le logement était propre, bien situé et correspondait à la description. Je recommande ce Airbnb.
We really enjoyed our stay in Castlebar! Perfect location, lovely house and great facilities
Great spot in an excellent location.

A nice cabin which was exactly as listed. Both Siobhan and her father were extremely friendly and helpful, providing directions to downtown Macroom and also our next destination. I would highly recommend this listing.
Great hosts

We were at a wedding in Kilshane House and Patrick's AirBnB was very close. He gave us the number of a local, very obliging taxi.This house is a recently refurbished old house with new bedrooms, bathrooms and kitchen.It was better than a lot of hotels I stayed in. We were a group of 3. The house would be even better value for a group of six.It was very comfortable and spotlessly clean.We didn't use the kitchen for our stay but I'm confident everything would work just fine.

Good place to stay in Cork for a great price. Conveniently located, walkable to the rest of the city and to buses. I didn't need much assistance, but Rong told me ahead of time when the door code for the building changed, so that was helpful. All in all, a good experience.
Wonderful view of inch beach from sitting room and only 20 min or so from Dingle area. Nice staff and great breakfast
Glynn was so helpful and responsive when we had any questions. The property is fab and there are nice local walks, and not far from other local sites!

We had so much fun in Ireland staying at Brians place. We loved the street his apartment was on.. the people watching from the coffee shop to the pub made us feel like we got a true Irish experience. We could walk to all the sites which made it nice. Can’t wait to visit again!

Mary’s place was lovely to stay at! Very close to town with lots of little shops and pubs. Quiet location. Grocery store and gas station just down the street. A couple of small things to be aware of but that did not make-or-break our stay: the sink is located in the bedroom and the shower is on the smaller side. Overall still recommend if you are staying in Clifden!

We thought this AirBnb was great overall. Incredible location, super easy check in and all communication was helpful and friendly. The apartment is very big and spacious and private and has everything you need. It’s also a great area to explore Dublin from but also to enjoy quiet evenings in a very chill neighbourhood. A lot of supermarket, pub, coffee and food options literally around the corner too.The only downside is the check in @ 4pm and check out @ 10am which felt a little extreme. We had late flights on the departure day and felt a later check out should have been possible. Otherwise it was all perfect.

Very pleasant house, well situated for enjoying the magnificent region.Vincent is very responsive and available. The house is clean and has everything you need for a great family holiday. Foxford is a pleasant little town with shops, pubs and restaurants nearby.
Agnes is fantastic, for sure you have to know...house very well located.
A truly outstanding building and wonderful restoration job...we hhad a fantastic stay ..highly recommended. Thanks to Carmel and Liam.
Die Unterkunft war sehr schön mit einem wunderschönen Ausblick. Jedoch war es ziemlich kalt, obwohl es Heizungen gab.

Had a lovely stay in Brid's palce. It's a big loft, fully furnished and comfortable. It's almost in the village and beside the bus stop into town. Brid is happy to chat or let you do your own thing. I would stay here again and I would recommend it anyone. Spiddal is lovely and very relaxing.

Cannot recommend staying here enough. Firstly Elaine and her dad Michael (who handled our keys handover) were beyond helpful! The house is beautiful, so spacious for our group, and everyone had great night sleeps. The location is amazing, you cannot be closer to the hustle and bustle, yet it's quiet at night. Will definitely return, thanks Elaine and Michael for making our weekend extra special 😊
The chalet is perfect. The peace and quiet is amazing .The only noise is the wind and the rain

Location exactly what we were looking for. House very comfortable and reasonably clean. Few small appliances which were not working but nothing that impacted our stay really. We travelled down using an electric car with multiple chargers positioned within walking distance of the house (Aldi, main car park & Supervalu).

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Keith’s place. It was the perfect location for all of the touristy things we wanted to do, which included the Ring of Kerry. The town of Killarney was fun to explore and easy to do from Keith’s place. The parking lot location was less than a 5 min walk from the Airbnb. We had a GREAT stay!!! My daughter and I highly recommend this place!!!
A beautiful cottage in a stunning location, well equipped and cosy with the log burning stove. Highly recommended

Ce logement est très mignon et pratique. La localisation est juste incroyable au milieu de la campagne avec des moutons, une vue sur un lac et sur la mer dont la plage est accessible à pied en moins de 5min. Magnifique pour le coucher de soleil ! L’hôte est extrêmement gentille et agréable se souciant de la qualité de notre séjour. Lorsque nous sommes arrivés, l’hôte nous avait préparé un feu de cheminée et avait préparé un cake également. Une adorable personne ! Je recommande ce logement à 100%
An excellent accommodation in a very nice and peaceful area. The hosts are amazing and very responsive. I would gladly recommend this spot to anyone and will probably be going again

Maria’s place was fantastic and she was even better! The space was clean and comfortable and she provided some nice snacks which I always consider a bonus. Tullamore is a great little town and Maria is a short walk from all the action. She recommended a great pub for music. Maria responded quickly to any questions and was a pleasure to chat with.
Très bon séjour étape. Merci

Me and my partner had a beautiful and peaceful stay at the boathouse. Everything was beyond expectations and Amiee and Joe were super friendly and helpful, even giving us last minute lifts to and from the Airbnb when our phone sims wouldn’t work to call a taxi! I highly recommend this place and we hope to be back soon! The friendly kitty and the lovely dogs were another highlight along with the cove which was only a couple minutes walk away and absolutely gorgeous! DEFINITELY stay here!
Large, clean and comfortable house. Great location close to Kenmare, in a lovely quiet setting close to lots of attractions. We really enjoyed our stay.
Absolutely fabulous stay, the location is amazing. I couldn't recommend it enough.
Orla was a wonderful host. Her apartment is very clean and modern, only a few minutes walk from town.

Lovely stay. Amenities were wonderful, especially the shower. Bed was maybe one of the most comfortable of the places we stayed. Great kitchen to make almost any meal. Next to the parking lot is a lookout over the river and a bridge view that was remarkable. And it got dark enough to see the stars at night. Great place to stay, would highly recommend.
Picturesque setting! The town was perfect too. We were very cosy.

The warmth & welcome from Frank & Suibhan was exceptional. From the moment of my booking Frank was a great communicator, keen to make our stay fulfilling & enjoyable. We felt like old friends from our first meeting. The house is extremely comfortable & well appointed. In a location that is peaceful & away from the just& bustle of Killarney. We had an exceptional stay & thoroughly enjoyed our long chats and discussions with Frank, a highly intelligent, knowledgeable, charismatic host. An Irish welcome, like no other. Perfect.
Great stay eith everything you need! So close to everything. Very helpful host. Very comfortable bed. Netflix and prime on a big tv for relaxing in the evening. Thanks Deni!

Booked Anne's house in Cong because of its proximity to the village, just a 2 minute walk away from the pubs and restaurants of Cong. Great location and very pretty surroundings. The house has five bedrooms all with en-suite which was ideal for all of us. Spacious kitchen with seating area to all congregate. Very clean and comfortable. We arrived a little early, Anne and Hugh had the house ready for us and were there to meet us. I would definitely recommend this house and hopefully will be back in the near future.

Lisa is incredibly responsive, and the location of her house is stunning! The photos on the website don’t do it justice—you have to see it in person to truly appreciate it. The property is enormous, offering enjoyable spaces both indoors and outdoors. It’s perfect for all age groups and any type of celebration. For us, it was an ideal retreat from the hustle and bustle, allowing us to spend quality family time and recharge. Absolutely a 10/10!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the airbnb. Patrick the host was friendly and we enjoyed chatting with him. The place was clean and neat. loved the chickens walking around the property. we even saw a black fox at dusk one of the nights. all in all we were extremely satisfied.
Very Nice and cozy place. Had a great time there!!
Cottage avec une vue magnifique sur montagne et mer !
We had a brilliant stay in this beautiful apartment. Clean, well equipped and in a great location! Edel is a welcoming and very helpful host.
Nice spot, lovely and cosy cabin. Thanks for having us Sharon!
brilliant place to stay close to anything you want touring or just the beach
We loved the cottage again so much. Tracey has thought of everything!! We will be back again!
Our stay was so lovely! I wish we had time to stay longer!
Hot tub was a great way to spend some days relaxing. Michelle is a great host.
Good value for money stay in beautiful County Donegal with Leo's tavern across the street. Place was easy to check into, clean and well located. Would recommend.

We spent a week at Mary's accommodation. The accommodation is very nice, well located with great views of the sea and the Cliffs of Moher. Mary is very friendly and responded quickly to our enquiries. We felt at home. We will definitely go there again.
Had a great holiday in Walters place. Quiet, cosy cottage with a big courtyard area for the kids to play in safely. We'll definitely be back!
I stayed with Nikki & Niall for two nights to visit a friend in Bray and plan to stay there again next time I am in the city.
The house is fabulous and very spacious. Town nearby is small but Carrick is close which is full of life!
Very nice accommodations. 3-10 minute walk to many restaurants in Doolin and 20 minute drive to Cliffs of Moher.
Beautiful house felt like home from home
home for home
Great Place & People to be there¡¡¡¡¡¡¡ and in a super area near the beach, I will miss the moorning walkings
lovely stay, finally was sound and made us feel at home. Will return again in the future great base for travelling around mayo. lovely pints in the pub too
Wonderful!
Great place to stay, host were very kind and eager to visit with us. Long live the king!
Gavin was very accommodating and extremely helpful in every possible way. A cosy and lovely house and will definitely be returning at some point in the future.
We had a great stay. Nice location close to both Falcarragh & Dunfanaghy and the beautiful local beaches.

The room is an apartment near the city centre. When you get to the first floor you’ll have to look for your room among the other rented rooms. The kitchen is big and well equipped. The cleanliness level in the rooms is optimal, it’s ok in the shared spaces. The hosts are always available and helpful online, although I never met them in person. Overall it’s a good compromise for a few nights in Cork!

So convenient. Sineads apartment is right in the centre of the town. Car park 2 minutes away and 3 euro per day, though you only need a car for journeys out to the surrounding countryside and beaches. Tourmakeady Falls should be on everyones list.
Esperienza positiva, appartamento carino e molto comodo in zona periferica ma tranquilla.Host disponibile, consiglio questo alloggio.

We have stayed in a number of Air BNB’s all over the world. This was the cleanest and most well stocked Air BNB so far. Beautiful location to explore the Dublin and the countryside. Janet and Pat were wonderful hosts and had great recommendations for places to explore. We will keep this on our list for friends and family who will be travelling to Dublin in the future.
Jimmy was very kind and was always able to help in anything. The place was so nice and Jimmy made all very easy.If we come back, we will definitely go back there !

This was by far the best place we have ever stayed. The surroundings are beautiful, It's a short walk into downtown Dingle, the house was fantasic, and Maire and her husband are the best hosts we've ever had. Thank you for making our time in Dingle the best we could have hoped for.
Good place for a place to stay before the airport. Clean and tidy. Good facilities apart from nowhere to sit and eat.
Absolutely stunning place. Perfect for a relaxing getaway

Conor's place was a highlight for us in Dublin. After a day of exploring, it was a delight to spend time in the space that he has created. We sincerely appreciated his help, clear communication and the quality of his home. I would definitely stay there again. Perfect for a family.

John and Mairead were great hosts, communication was great, the hut was better than expected, clean, really cosy and comfortable! We had a great night to recharge in a peaceful quiet area, would highly recommend a stay here!

Lovely stay, very relaxing and secluded. We really enjoyed our time here. One very minor issue was sorted very quickly with an email. Ricky replied right away with an easy solution. Would stay again, for longer!

My family enjoyed a lovely weekend stay with Pauline and her family. We were made feel very welcome and it was so relaxing. The location is very convenient to Donegal Town with beautiful views. My 3 children loved playing there and we're delighted with their breakfast. Pauline and her family were a pleasure to meet and I would definitely recommend their home if a relaxing comfortable stay is what you are after.
A fabulous place to stay, in the most beautiful surroundings. Everything we needed for a great stay was there along with thoughtful additions and a real welcome. Just lovely!
bonita casita, y anfitriona muy amable

Stayed at Yvonne's and Richard's boathouse in Baltimore in early August. We had a wonderful stay in a very peaceful and tranquil setting. The boathouse is very well equipped and easy to use. The walks were great and Sherkin Island a great day trip particularly to the lovely Silver Strand beach. Weather did not really play ball for us but nonetheless had a great stay . The two resident dogs Dot and Booboo are adorable and spent most of our holiday with us . We were tempted to stick them in the back of the car when leaving !! Great base for seeing West Cork and great hosts with lots of advise on hand. No hesitation in recommending for a couple or small family.

An absolute gem! Beautiful location directly at Ross castle with lovely walks in the area. The cottage itself has a lot of space, is beautifully decorated and offers the perfect place to get away from the busy city life. Would definitely stay here again!
Had a lovely stay in Margaret's apartment. A great host with easy check in and the apartment itself is very comfortable and is superbly located. This was our second trip and we will be back again.
great stay. perfect for our group. Ashley was responsive and gave good recommendations. I would visit again.

Great location . Within walking distance to everything. 10 minute walk to tour pickup locations. Great pubs and restaurants nearby. A Quik 5 minute cab ride to O connors Famous pub. Ed Sheeran’s Galway Girl video filmed here. Super eclectic bar with a crazy amount of antiques everywhere. We listened to a great folksinger on a Monday night. The people who run this place are super nice.
Excellent emplacement idéal . Instructions d accueil claires .

Location, house, hosts - all a 5 star experience.Our large group had a wonderful stay. The house was very comfortable and spacious, it was exactly what we needed. The stove was lighting on our arrival, which was an excellent welcoming gesture. Olivia had also left a welcome basket of food which was a welcome surprise. Can’t wait to return!

Me, my husband and another couple stayed in Cathal's place. We were only there for two days but we all left wishing we had stayed longer. The views were nothing like I've experienced. The mornings are peaceful and you feel like you are part of the cliffside neighborhood. I recommend getting up early to have a coffee on the picnic table and listen to the birds and sheep. Dingle is about a 20 minute drive from the house which was great, we used a taxi service one night so we could go to some pubs. It was super easy to book and the driver was wonderful. Everything you need and more is in Cathal's detailed handbook! I recommend walking down to the hidden beach right down the road from the cottage. We made many memories here and definitely will be back if we can!

A lovely place to stay! Tina was super friendly and helpful, and very understanding about our transport delays. The room was clean and cozy and the cafe downstairs was lovely. Would definitely recommend!
Remote and rustic, the beds were so comfortable and the surroundings so quiet we slept so well!

Good value for money, very comfortable. Closer to Leap village than g maps would lead you to believe. Blinds were broken and the room was extremely warm. But a positive experience and a lovely spot. Would recommend.

We spent three nights in the Ox Mountain cabin. It’s really quiet and spacious. We heard so many birds just outside the cabin including a cuckoo! It’s really away from the main road so super quiet and having the owners on site was great just to know they were there if we had any questions. They have some very lovely animals including Hunter who came down to hang out with us sometimes! We used it a a base for a lot of walking, visiting Neolithic sites including Ceide Fields, Carrowmore and Carrowkeel, and going to lots of nice places to eat. Cabin is cosy and there was fuel for the stove in the evenings if needed. Lots of hot water and beds very comfy. Lots of midges though as is in the mountains! Next time we would bring a citronella candle as it’s a lovely place to sit outside and drink wine and listen to the birds! Also a great place for star watching. It’s very dark at night and you can see the stars very clearly. Thanks again Dermot and Monica. It was a great base!

Kitty’s Cottage was a great place to stay—very clean and charming cottage with ample space and beautiful natural surroundings. This cottage is a bit remote if you are visiting the area without a car rental. However, there is a local taxi driver named Dennis who was very helpful. Kitty’s cottage is about a 20 minute drive to Cliffs by car/taxi and not far from Doolin. Would definitely recommend this place especially if you are driving and have time to explore the area.

Lovely stay in a beautiful setting, loads of hospitality - she brought fans just in case it got too warm! Very thoughtful touches, gorgeously appointed and designed - felt like a true getaway! A great spot for a weekend away with our pup, can't wait to return!
Class place,great hosts,we will def be back.......xx
Adorable and comfortable stay

What a beautiful historic home! The gardens made for an incredible peaceful wander, the neighbourhood running was picturesque. Retiring to the living room to read and listen to music was the perfect end to long summer days.
Sinead is a wonderful host and the room was very comfortable and well appointed. The location is ideal for exploring downtown Dublin and close to parking. It was perfect for our stay in Dublin.
Lovely house, comfortable for a large group, would recommend for over 5 people, for us it was a little wasted space.However, very clean, comfortable, and well equipped.

the cottage stay at Betty's was great. we had a very pleasant stay . the place was very clean and we were provided with all basic things at the house. Betty was very friendly and gave recommendations to look around which helped us a lot she was very responsive. totally recommend it

je recommande ce logement dans un quartier calme et proche du centre de Dublin.ce sont des hôtes discret , et avenant pour les bons conseils pour les visites à faire . ma chambre était cosy comme j'aime et le petit déjeuné complet . Merci à eux pour leur accueil.

Logement atypique décoré avec beaucoup de goût. On s’y sent vraiment bien !Il y a des activités à 10 minutes en voitures (plonger, surf, piscine, randonnées… et tant d’autres.)Ann est une superbe hôte, elle est aux petits soins si vous avez besoin de quelques choses et est de très bons conseils si vous voulez découvrir les environs.Peut être à une prochaine fois 😊
Beautiful place!

We were so impressed with Róisín's place. The space is so much more than just a room and very private. The perfect place to rest our heads after a day on the lake. Would have stayed longer if we could have!
Great getaway in an idyllic setting. Caoimhe is the perfect host, very hands off and lets you do your own thing. Lovely clean cottage with everything you could need. Would absolutely come back
We had a great Time ! Keith is a very kind and easy hors, we recommand !

This was the perfect cosy cabin for a lovely weekend in Wexford! There was so much attention to detail including fresh flowers, freshly made flap jacks and vintage board games. We could hear the waves at night and it was less than a 5 minute walk to the beach. Cant recommend this place enough!
Superbe maison,cosy, vue imprenable sur l’océan, bien située et beaucoup d’activités alentours. Bonne communication, je recommande.

Aoife was a very welcoming host who took time to ensure everything was both sanitary and comfortable in her flat. There were no issues at all with accessibility or communication and we enjoyed our 2-night stay!

John stay is definitively the place if what u look for is a time away from the city and get a bit isolated. No LAN/WiFi Internet but pretty decent phone Internet signal although not really needed with the stunning views of the area. The walk along the river, once u cross the wee forest are just wonderful. Debbie (neightbor in charge of the welcoming) was great and waited for us (we were very late cu we got lost). if u follow the instructions is very easy to get there.. but I agree with comments of John on the profile, Do not follow Google maps.. it leads you to the end of the road, and easily skipped the turn to your right..
Very clean apartment in a good location, Ann was very approachable and accomodating to our needs :)
Brid is one of the best hosts I've ever had. The room is very clean, the house is warm and welcoming and kindness is guaranteed. It was a pleasure to stay here for a while.

We really enjoyed our stay at Steph’s place. Lovely stone cottage which was quite spacious, yet cozy at the same time. Perfect for a couple or a family. Everything that was needed was there & Steph was really helpful & open with her communication & local knowledge on things to see and do. 5 stars ;)

This was a beautiful stay! A very comfortable accommodation with the most beautiful surroundings and views. Jennifer was very helpful with local recommendations and with helping us to organise a taxi. We wish we were able to stay longer.

Thank you Sinead for a fantastic weekend, our group thoroughly enjoyed our time and hope to come back again in the future. Greatly appreciated how friendly and comfortable you made us all feel and the location was beautiful and peaceful. Thanks again
Lovely home and great location. Restaurants were great in town and we enjoyed our stay.
We had a great stay- Deirdre and Kieran ae wonderful hosts and the place was very comfortable. Highly recommend.
Toller Aufenthalt in Caherciveen. Sehr gute Betreuung durch Uschi, auch für längere Aufenthalte sehr zu empfehlen!
Lovely little spot. Out of the way, quiet and cozy. Recommend!
Everything's perfect, we had a very good break away from work and school. would love to go back again. Mary was so generous and easily be contacted. House was very clean and tidy. 100% for all of us

My stay with Cherry and her family was very nice! Despite being out most of the time I appreciated the chat I had with her and her family. Would definitely stay again, transportation was very easy to central Dublin and the suggestion to use the leap card was very helpful with saving money. It takes about an hour by bus to get to central Dublin. Communication was very easy so if you need anything they will get back to you fairly quickly.

This is such a great base to explore Galway from, only a 10 minute drive from the city centre. The room itself is super clean and tidy, and has all the amenities you could possibly want. Lorraine is a great host and I wouldn't hesitate to stay with her again.
Un emplacement très proche du centre tout en étant au calme. Tout était propre et conforme à la description. Paddy est très réactif et donne de très bons conseils. Je recommande vivement ce logement!
We had a great stay at the appartment. Everything was clean and we felt at home right away. Communication was very quick and easy. Thank you!

Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt. Das B&B liegt wunderschön in der Natur und wir wurden ganz herzlich empfangen. Das Frühstück war auch gut. Highly recommended, were invited to local pub for a party which was great nice views from the room windows, spacious rooms 1and bathroom, access to dining table as well as kitchen which is great. Thank you

Great place to stay, we had a spacious room with 2 comfortable beds and a very clean bathroom. Mary gave us some advice for activities in the vicinity and made our stay very pleasant. We can absolute recommend.
Great place to stay! David is super communicative and made sure we had everything we needed! Would highly recommend!
It was a fab location and Kevin was a pleasure to deal with. I would really recommend it.
Vanessa and Matti are excellent hosts and the location is nice and secluded. Workshop is amazing and well kitted-out. Great stay!
A lovely oasis close to town surrounded in mountain views and horse fields. Was a lovely spot for a few nights and lived the welcoming by Sydney the dog.
This place was in the perfect location on the main street in town and near all the pubs. Frances was great with recommendations for music.

I feel like we found an absolute gem. I cannot recommend our stay enough. Kamile was so helpful and super quick to respond. Fabulous recommendations given and very attentive to our requests. The place was spotlessly clean and done to an extremely high standard to the last detail in that it felt like a hotel standard with the lovely robes and shower facilities. Very cosy and comfortable. The bed was just beautiful. The hot tub was an added bonus! This place is highly recommended if you have a car. We will most definitely be staying here the next time we are in County Kerry!

As amazing as this place looks in the pictures it doesnt do it justice. Great place to stay and location is superb. The dogs are a very nice touch too great company. The place was spotless and very well equipped with everything you will need for your stay.Will definitely stay here again
Lovely cosy cottage, ideal for travelling to local towns . Peaceful surroundings. Love it.
Fantastic stay in an amazing location

The pod is exactly what it says on the tin!Really enjoyed the stay, very clean and very cosy.Steve has added alot of touches that add to the experience such as a folder with all the local restaurants and takeaways menus and contact info! Agnes ist nicht leicht zu finden, aber schließlich angekommen, fanden wir uns an einem unglaublich ruhigen, verträumten und friedvollen Ort wieder. Logement très propre et fonctionnel. Con et son épouse sont très sympathiques et sont toujours là en cas de problème.Adresse à recommander.
Wonderful stay. Full marks for a lovely cottage with some dinky areas! Will definitely be back!
This was our third vist here and wont be our last, we love it.
Very friendly hosts Appreciated the tea/cake/ chat each evening

Si vous passez dans le coin et que vous ne savez pas où vous arrêter, alors c'est ici qu'il faut aller! Tony est l'hôte parfait et son logement est exactement ce que l'on attend d'un Airbnb. Merci à lui pour les conseils et son accueil chaleureux.

This is one of the best airbnb we ever visited! The place is amazing! We loved the chickens running around and the cute doggo. Unfortunately the host was sick so her doughter show us the place and told everything and she was really nice and helpful! A lovely house in a great location. Very comfortable and had everything we needed. The terrace at the back has gorgeous views of Tramore. Highly recommended.

Amazing place and view. You have your own privacy, the rooms are beautiful its decorated with taste...You couldnt get nicer host. They are so nice and friendly and look after you...very close to achill wich is perfect..The place is so peaceful it is so relaxing
Lovely cozy home, so convenient to the Luas, and an easy 25 minute walk to Grafton St. We would definitely stay here again.
Great location. Quite loud at night but that’s to be expected. Rooms are very well equipped! Would stay again.

We had a lovely stay at the Jewel Lodge & Spa. Keelin was a lovely host, very friendly and welcoming. The spa was very unique, so relaxing and very well created. We very much enjoyed the plunge pool! We would really recommend staying here.

Had a nice stay overall. Away from the street, quiet community. Close to railway but train is barely heard. Some continuous creaking noises but all good.Had a broken lamp - was fixed within 4 hours of report.Balcony leads to a second apartment but this is honestly not a hinderance unless you overvalue privacy.

We arrived at 2.30 in the morning, after an extremely long journey from the UK. The rural setting of the cottage was perfect for our needs. We were a little concerned about finding it In the absolute darkness. However, it was easy to spot, lights were left on, it looked so inviting. The heating was turned up. A pleasant radio station was tuned in, there was fresh homemade loaf, marmalade and eggs for our breakfast. Even the sky was outstanding that night!!! We’ve never seen such a star studded delight. Not down to Peter obviously, it just added an extra special feeling. A magnificent fabulous welcome. Peter is a charming, kind knowledgeable host. All his recommendations for outings were spot on, I would say follow them and you’ll see the very best that Co Wicklow has to offer. It was one of our most relaxing short breaks. Highly recommended. Thanks again Peter and Bruno
magnifique reposant

Exactly as described in the pictures, what you see is what you get, and what you see is really nice. Very straightforward arrival process, good directions and a comfortable place to stay, with useful information about the area. Just lovely.
Fabulous house. Clean and well equipped. Great location for going to a wedding in Castle Leslie.

Hvis man gerne vil væk fra de meget turistede områder og opleve Irland, så er dette en rigtig god mulighed. Huset er hyggelig og fungerede godt til en famile på fem med voksne børn.Vertinden var meget hjælpsom. Der er tre pubs i gå afstand, hvoraf vi spiste på Cox steakhouse (prøv deres steaksandwich) og The Brandywell. Begge virkelige gode og velbesøgte. Gode muligheder for gåture og udflugter. Jeg fremhæver surfing i Strandhill og the Arigna Mining Experience.
A lovely stay with family for 2 nights

The accommodation met our expectations exactly and we had a wonderful holiday. The surroundings are very quiet, but Ballydehob is only a few minutes away by car. West Cork is simple the perfect surrounding vor hiking and enjoying the landscape. The absolute highlight is of course the barrel sauna. It's simply wonderful to end the day in the sauna - simply amazing. We would come back anytime and it is a clear recommendation for anyone looking for peace and quiet and a bit of some privacy.
A beautiful property in an idealic part of county Mayo. Very clean, lovely decor and a warm welcome from the owners. We loved the open fire, it kept us warm on the winters night.

Grainne and Leo were great hosts. Very responsive and provided great tips that improved our trip and helped greatly! The house was comfortable and everything worked great. Highly recommend if you have family or friends traveling with you.
Checkin was very easy, comfortable stay for the night. Trish was a great host.
Very good location, close to the city center (10 mn walking) but very quiet place.
Great for groups

Pops Dream lived up to everything I had imagined and more. The location is beautiful and so peaceful. Barry is a wonderful host who went out of his way to help us and answer any questions we had. He prepared the barbecue for us before we arrived and provided firewood for the stove. Bring swimwear as the water is actually very mild and nice for a swim.
Beautiful location with the majestic Benbulbin mountain view. Very clean and cozy hut with all the necessary kitchen and washroom amenities provided. Would love to go again.
Very pleasant B&B. Ideally located to visit Connemara. Ann was very welcoming, and the room was great.
Super stay. Really good. Spotless charming great host.
Marcella gave great instructions and is a very efficient communicator. The property was beautiful and very clean. I highly recommend this place!
A clean, nicely furnished room with private bathroom. We really liked the little touches from the hostess. Especially the view in the morning directly onto the sea is wonderful.Highly recommended.
Fabulous family stay at Sandra’s Airbnb. The hot tub was a big hit with the kids, beautiful peaceful place. We will definitely be back!
Très bon séjour passer pour découvrir l’Irlande et le donegal Rally 👌

Ealaín and Fionn’s place was very comfortable and in a walkable area. I enjoyed chatting with Ealaín and meeting their cats. Both were great at communication. I would stay again if in the area.

Large, very clean house with plenty of space. Mary greeted us warmly and showed us the house. Kitchen had all we needed to cook and share dinner. Bedrooms were comfortable and showers were great. Upstairs sitting room with great views of the mighty Shannon was a terrific, surprise bonus. Enjoyed Casey's pub the night before we left. Thanks so much, Geraldine and Mary.
Great space for a group for a weekend exploring the city. Super responsive host. It’s not a tourist neighborhood, but it’s a quick walk to the sites.
we stayed at John Benny's while walking the dingle way. John was a great host, the location was perfect and service in the pub welcoming. would recommend this location
Fabulous location , great place to stay. Will def return.

You'll be happy in this place about 15 minutes walk along the river from the city centre. The house is very clean, very well organized and very nice. The room has got everything you need.Lovely place!

Very clean, very quaint two level home as advertised. The location is the real draw, as it’s next door to a Tesco and a five minute walk from the tourist center of Galway. The parking is very challenging, especially coming in for the first time - Google will direct you to the front of the home, but the parking is in the back and there’s no through street such that you can easily loop to get where you need to go. All the gates only open from the inside, adding to the challenge. I would book this again, but probably not if I had a car. Geraldine was very responsive when we needed assistance and check in/out was otherwise a breeze.
perfect!

Great place to spend a night, wish it could've been more than one. Mia and Simon were great hosts. We also did the Alpaca Treking, totally worth it. Great recommendation to have lunch at Helen's right on the water a short drive away. Would love to stay again!

This cottage is perfect for nature lovers who would like to relax and recharge their batteries. The area is absolutely beautiful and there are so many places to explore. Perfect for a family or group of friends.Besides the obvious beautiful view, we also loved all the special touches like the homemade brownies and fudge. As we traveled over the Christmas season the Christmas lights and candles in the cottage also made it extra special , we felt right at home from the moment that we walked through the door.
Everything was nice !

This apartment in Ireland is absolutely stunning, exceptionally well-equipped, and nestled in the midst of the natural surroundings. Additionally, Barbie was an excellent host who took great care of us during our stay.

A beautiful spacious, historical house with the most fantastic uninterrupted view of the Shannon that is yours alone! Bird and dolphin watching from the veranda any time of day is lovely! Our family loved our two week stay and look forward to visiting Susan again!

We stayed for one night. It felt like home. Nicola was a wonderful hostess. She even offered us some muesli, soda bread and jam for breakfast. We also loved the fireplace and Guiness at Mike Murt’s which was in a walking distance to the apartment. Thanks so much!
Ottima comunicazione, Sharon disponibile e accomodante. Luogo strategico per visitare alcuni posti incantevoli e soggiorno rilassante a un buon prezzo.

Die Türen wurden mit einem Code geöffnet. Die Codes hat Niall rechtzeitig geschickt. Es war ganz einfach. Das Appartement war genau wie auf den Bildern. Sehr schön und sauber. Es war alles neu. Die Dusche war ganz sauber. Herrlich. Eine Bushaltestelle ist ca. 5 Minuten weiter, bei der wichtige Buslinien abfahren. Genauso wie ein kleiner Supermarkt. Für mich war diese Unterkunft perfekt und ich habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt. Ich würde die Unterkunft jederzeit wieder nehmen und kann sie nur jedem empfehlen.

We spent 3 nights at the Lavender Studio. It is nicely located for Ring of Kerry, Dingle, and Kilarnny. David was very hospitable and helpful. He gave us many ideas for things to see and places to eat that were very local to the Lavender Studio. He loves the area and wants to share it with others. Everything inside was impeccable and clean.
Beautiful spot. Close to many things!

Het was nog mooier dan we dachten ! Wat een rust en wat een uitzicht ! En een geweldig ontvangst van de lieve schapen ! Alles wat je nodig hebt om ultiem te genieten van de rust en de natuur en toch alle luxe binnen voorzien! En een heel leuke dorpje op afstand en een prachtig natuurpark op een uurtje rijden! Wij komen hier zeker terug! Liefs Roy en Femke

Marion and Declan are lovely hosts. On arrival the homemade scones were a lovely touch. The wagon is a unique glamping experience and my daughter and I had a fun night (no wifi /phone distractions). Wagon was clean and warm and had everything we needed. Lovely walks all around the area. Thank you Marion and Declan x
Anthony is a very hospitable person who met all my needs. My family and I were very satisfied with our two days here. We look forward to staying here again when we visit Galway next time.

Lovely apartment in a great location in the centre of dingle. Very clean and a great size the hosts were also extremely friendly. The only issue was we didn’t realise it was attached to the house so it could be noisy at times as it’s not sound proofed. Would defiantly stay again though
What a beautiful experience we had in this tree house! I can't recommend it enough, it was amazing and Richard was absolutely lovely with us!
Lovely spot - rural location but close to Donegal town .
Martin was responsive and provided easy instructions for entry and recommendations around the area. We had a great time!

Great house, a little out of the way for going to town but due to Covid we stayed local. Brilliant restaurant and pub a 5min walk from the house! Old style house, cosy beds, everything you need. I would recommend to anyone. Thanks.

It was so serene and tranquil to stay in the cottage. The cottage really is the stuff of fairytales for a swede like me, so cosy and beautiful. The surrounding landscape is breathtaking. Our host William was fantastic and suggested some of the most stunning hikes we've ever been on. The cottage has everything you might need, full kitchen, hot shower etc. we had a great time cooking and curling up in front of the fire in the evening.

It's a delightful place to stay. Paul and Joan are charming people and good natured hosts. Quite professionally run also. The Stables and the house are in a beautiful setting and the interior is tasteful and comfortable. Location is ideal, as it is secluded but not remote. Would recommend it to anyone.
Great host, made my birthday weekend special!
Lovely little apartment for 2, nicely equipped and quiet.

Beautiful, peaceful place and Emilie is a lovely and friendly host! The room was truly lovely and I got an amazing 11hours sleep! Emilie has a very cute bakery in town worth checking out.If you’re walking the Kerry Way be sure to plan ahead (unlike me) and book a taxi or lift with Emilie. Otherwise the place is about 4km extra walk in the opposite direction on a sketchy road.

This was a great place to stay, close to downtown. We were able to walk about a mile to dinner which was very nice. The neighborhood was lovely. The host was very kind and made sure we had everything we needed. Would definitely stay here again!

The house was very clean and spacious. Close to Ballinamore. Brian met us as we arrived and explained all about the area, how the heating etc worked. The kitchen is well equiped with all you would need.So overall we had a nice few days bar tbe weather.

Il cottage di John è magico e offre una vera esperienza irlandese. La posizione è fantastica, di fronte al mare dove poter godere di meravigliosi tramonti. Tutto è tranquillo e silenzioso. A 10 minuti di auto ci sono ristoranti, pub e un supermercato. Abbiamo cucinato nel Cottage perché volevamo stare lì più tempo possibile. John ci ha fatto trovare un the caldo, qualche dolcetto e il camino acceso alimentato con la torba, davvero affascinante. Le camere sono spaziose e abbiamo dormito molto bene. La doccia era calda e con una buona pressione dell'acqua. Il tavolino all'esterno ci ha permesso di cenare guardando il tramonto sull'oceano. John è simpaticissimo, gentile e ci ha fornito tutte le informazioni sul cottage e sulla zona circostante. Ci sono pascoli di pecore attorno, qualche mucca nel recinto dietro la casa che veniva a curiosare quando uscivamo. Vorrei tornaci il prima possibile. Grazie John, a presto!

Many here have said it but there is just something special about Fiona's place. From the welcome sign and flowers to stocking us with snacks and goodies, we were just delighted at every turn. She even went out of her way to make sure she greeted us personally, even though we only stayed one night. Can't recommend this spot enough, amazing value for the stunning hospitality you receive.
Fantastic house for large family holiday. Great location. Maura and Pat were super hosts making us feel very welcome. Woukd highky recomnend.

Very clean and well equipped house and only 5 mins walk to the beach and restaurants. Only issue with the location is the poor cellular reception which was inconvenient at times but also afforded us a welcome break from our phones.
Cormac’s place was spotless & well equipped. You’ll get a warm welcome & a wealth of local knowledge.
Great house. Everything was perfect. Thanks Stephen

We enjoyed our stay at Michael’s place. It was a great location to access the small town of Glengarriff. I only wish we had more time to explore the area.While the apartment does not have WiFi, we did find an open connection at the Glengarriff Park hotel- both inside and at a picnic table outside the hotel.
Very peacefull. Lorenas place is beautifull.
Very nice house, 19 mins walk from the main beach in Kilmore quay. Good for even a large family.
Beautiful, comfortable and stylish place. Had everything we needed - especially when travelling with a toddler. One night was too short!
Philip’s home was a great stay that was in a lovely area close to everything in Dublin. It was such a welcoming, cozy space and Philip was responsive over chat and a wonderful host!

Roy was an awesome host! He was very responsive and flexible, letting us drop off our bags in the morning before check-in. His place is close to bus stops, fun restaurants, and delicious coffee shops. A good place to stay if you're visiting Dublin!

It was fantastic. Sean was a great host. Very friendly, responsive and helpful. The place was in perfect order, very close to the DART (local train station 1 minute away) to get to the inner city or the coast, still very quiet. I would not hesitate to book the place again. Highly recommended.

This is a really lovely property. It's comfortable with a wonderful mix of quirky period details and modern finish. Comfy beds, a pleasure to cook in the kitchen, everything spotlessly clean and easy to use. Even though you are attached to the owner's home, it felt very private and we felt welcome to play on the garden with our child. The host is friendly and gave great recommendations for things to do in the area. We went to Cahir castle, Mitchelstown Cave , Rock of Cashel and to Dungarvan and Clonea beach in Waterford... all recommended. Be aware the property has lots of stairs. Bring slippers as there are no shoes inside. It's a 15 minute drive to the town for groceries so you'll need a car and to plan for that. I would highly recommend this property and host and would stay here again.
Lovely and comfortable small apartment in a lovely city.

Todo estupendo. El barrio es muy tranquilo, la casa es preciosa y muy acogedora, tiene todo lo necesario y unas vistas impresionantes. Aoife nos dio muchos consejos sobre la zona y estuvo muy atenta a nosotros durante toda nuestra estancia. Muy recomendable

You will see the word perfect in pretty much all the reviews for The Mews and it really is. For location , comfort etc it was perfect for us. The Kitchen is well equipped for home cooking. The bed is King size (that's always a win in my book). The place is spacious and the surroundings are lovely. It was great seeing the horses and chickens on a daily basis. Sylvia, Dane and Laura were perfect hosts. The town of Kinsale is lovely I would definitely recommend The Mews for a long or short stay.
Nice house - Mountshannon is tranquil, blue flag beach and a couple of bars. Enough for kids and adults to enjoy... outdoorsy lake activities and looped walking routes abound.
Lovely room , perfectly clean, great location, very quiet.
Perfect place to stay for going to a wedding !
This is a lovely home in a great place with enclosed gardens for the grandkids.

Lesson learned: Never will I stay at a new listing with no reviews again! This place was not cleaned between guests. The beds were slept in and unmade, dirty towels lying around, trash on the floor and in the trash cans, leftover takeout food in the fridge, dishes on counter not put away. I immediately contacted Fiona through the app but she didn't answer. After waiting two hours for a response, I got Airbnb involved. They called her and got her to send someone over at 9 pm with clean sheets and towels. I got to change the sheets. Airbnb got her to send a cleaner over the next day but it was halfway through my stay. The wifi never worked the whole time and Fiona was no help. The cell phone service only worked upstairs. To make matters worse, Fiona never once apologized to me for any of this hassle. I do not recommend staying here.
Cosy little place with all that you need, all clean. Nice hosts too.

Tony was there waiting for us, he showed us how everything worked which is great. He recommended places to go and had lots of leaflets for day trips in the house. The house was lovely and cosy. The organic homemade bread was the best part of the trip. thank you so much Tony xx
Very clean house in an excellent location. Couldn’t fault it.

This spot is right above all the action at Temple Bar. It is an ideal location for exploring Dublin by foot and enjoying the festive atmosphere. With the double-windows down, there wasn't even much noise from the bars below when trying to rest at night (although earplugs are offered for sensitive guests). One bedroom is a little small, but the sofa bed in the living room is more generous. Be prepared to take the stairs as I didn't spot an elevator option for guests. The control for the hot water (if multiple guests need hot showers back-to-back) is a little unusual but the explanation is posted on the wall.
This place is immaculate and in Leap village. Nice room, really comfortable bed and good shower. Car park metres away. Really handy and beside the bars for food and drinks.
Apartamento ótimo. Super novo com todas comodidades.Localização muito boa com transporte público à porta.Local com muitos parques públicos próximos.

We needed a space between Galway and Athenry. Perfect for our needs. Great location..walkable to town not far from Galway city. Great hosts who were very responsive to any requests. will definitely keep this in mind for any future trips. Thanks Daniel
Lovely home in great location within easy reach of all the great places in W. Cork. The hot tub was a lovely touch and the walks with the dogs were also great.
Great place to stay, will definitely return again for a weekend
all confort , nice place.

Le logement est idéalement situé à Doolin, à environ 20 minutes à pieds du Ferry, à 5 minutes de bus pour rejoindre les falaises de Moher. Le logement est très propre et la literie très confortable. Sean et sa femme sont des hôtes tres accueillants, plein de gentillesse et de bienveillance. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour et nous recommandons vivement!

A really warm welcome from Deirdre her house is beautiful. My room was lovely, the bed was very cosy and little bathroom was perfect. it was a quiet room at the far end of the house. I would definitely stay again.
Great place and location

Myself, partner and dog stayed a couple of nights over a long weekend and it was a lovely place to stay. Erin and Joe were lovely and the location is quite a close drive to beaches, views and good food.

We felt right at home here. The ambiance was very cozy. You can tell they really made an effort to make the place as comfortable as possible. We loved the lazy chairs, the soft blankets and the music posters.Downstairs in the pub they serve delicous home made pizza’s with a Great selection of brews and the best gluten free pizza ever! Ps Make sure you don’t hang your jacket in the little hall if you don’t want to be basking in pizza scent the next day, however great the taste;)We will definitely be back!
We had a lovely time in Micheáls cottage, prefect place to get away from it all and base selves for exploring Connemara- lovely beaches and places to eat in the area. Highly recommend!!
We only stayed one night, but it was perfect for what we needed
We had a lovely stay at Marcella’s. An absolutely pristine room in her beautiful home. We were served a fabulous breakfast. Marcella and her husband were great hosts.

This is a case of small is beautiful. The house is very well presented and spotless. Worked great for our family of 4. Don’t be put off by its location on the side of a busy street as once you close the front door it’s pretty quiet. Parking close by on the side of the road is easy or across in a small public car park. Location is great as you can walk to everything in Ennistymon but don’t walk past Unglerts bakery without buying some fresh bread or tarts. Or walk a little further to the Cheese Press.
She was very helpful with information to the point we stayed an extra night in the area. She gave printed itineraries for our next few stops.
Thanks for a great stay.

A really beautiful house renovated to an exceptionally high standard. Very comfortable throughout with excellent modern and high quality facilities. The hosts are very welcoming and helpful and go out of their way to ensure a memorable stay. As mentioned, it is necessary to drive to Ballyvaughan and the local minbus is a great option and run by really lovely people. The stunning views of The Burren from the house will stay with me throughout the winter....
Cute & cosy for couples x

John and Veronica’s cottage is an oasis of tranquility in a noisy, busy world. The location is stunning - private beach, private surroundings and lovely animal friends to keep you company when you wander outside. John is an excellent host. Thanks for everything, John!
Had a lovely stay. Karen's place was nice and clean, located in a quiet neighborhood and only a stone's throw away from St Anne's Park. Good links to the town as well.

Gorgeous stay, really magical cabin. Tucked away in Union woods, but yet not a far cycle from anywhere i.e. 45mins to Sligo town or 40mins to Strandhill. The cabin itself is so cosy, the wood burning stove is hard to leave and there’s so much space for an open-plan cabin. We’d definitely be back!
Lovely quaint little house! Cosy feels!
Sehr schönes kleines Townhouse. Liebevoll, einfach und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Sehr zentral gelegen, dadurch aber abends auch etwas lauter.
Kieran was a fantastic host and will definitely be coming back to stay again.

Can't thank Tessa enough for the stay in her lovely cottage with my parents. It was super convenient to stay nearby the wedding in Cloughjordan house and be able to get ready nearby the venue. Beautiful cottage, tidy, well furnished and homely.I cannot single out the best part of the cottage, it is all to an exceptional standard.

We stayed a night in Orlas accomodation at late notice. We were very pleased with the room and facilities available to us. The snacks and breakfast were an added bonus. Michael

Nous avons été agréablement surpris par ce logement, très bien décoré avec charme et goût, de jolies peintures, linge de lit propres, la maison est pratique, de belles balades à pied et dans les environs. Mary a été de bons conseils et très réactives par message. On se sent facilement chez soi.

Helen‘s place in Dublin was absolutely perfect! It was within walking distance of many restaurants, pubs and historical attractions. Helen herself as a hostess was the best! She met us at the Airbnb and gave many helpful recommendations about the area. I would not hesitate to recommend her Airbnb to anyone who is in the Dublin area. If I get a chance to get back to Dublin, I would, certainly rent her Airbnb again.

Great location for our (too) short trip around the area. Lovely accommodation worked well for us. Could have done with a couple of extra kitchen utensils, but otherwise it was fine for our purposes. A well located place, lovely and quiet.

This was our favorite stay during our time in Ireland! The hut was absolutely adorable and squeaky clean. Dana was an excellent host. We would recommended this place to anyone wanting to stay near Cork. I wish we could have stayed longer! 🙂

Absolutely beautiful house and surrounds! The house was perfect, so clean and beautifully decorated! Ashleigh was so helpful and considerate as we were staying with two little ones and provided high chair and travel cot! Nothing was a bother! Will definitely stay here every time we are down visiting family in the future! A home away from home with added bonus of a beautiful friendly dog 🥰
perfect place :)

Sineads place was lovely & bright and super clean and tastefully decorated. She has a nice enclosed yard with a trampoline and swing set where my granddaughter played daily when we weren’t on tours. Sinead was very flexible with check in & out, which we greatly appreciated. We would definitely rent from her again.
Robert is a great hostPlace acted like a home from homeWouldn’t hesitate to recommend or stay again
Lovely house, perfect for a couple. Short walk to town centre.
Thank you so much for a wonderful stay. My family and I had a wonderful weekend. We will defiantly be back!

Fantastic apartment very close to Ballyheigue beach and town. The view from every room is just spectacular and the apartment is lovely, spacious and extremely clean. Laura is a very helpful host and very quick to respond and help with any queries ... only sorry we had to leave! Will definitely be back😁

This is a very comfortable cottage with a wonderful view on the sea and islands that constantly change with the tides and the light. There is a nice walk to the castle along the pebble beach and we enjoyed swimming on the beautiful sandy beach. ( only 3 minutes drive from the cottage). Connemara National Park is about a 12minute drive from the cottage.
We had a great stay, the room was fantastic, had a great meal down stairs and all the staff were really nice.Everyone made us feel so welcome
Wonderful host! Very accommodating, even with our super last minute reservation. The room was perfect, the bathroom was gorgeous, and the shower water pressure was amazing!
Beautiful place, felt like a cosy home !
Fantastic cottage, with everything you need to have a pleasant stay.

Merci à Martina pour ce séjour ! La chambre proposée est spacieuse et la vue est juste wouaouh ! Nous y avons séjourné avec un bébé et il a pu se dégourdir les pattes ! La vue à 360° sur la baie de Liscannor est juste incroyable, merci encore pour votre accueil !

Eine wundervolle schnuckelige Unterkunft mit einer sehr gastfreundlichen und liebevollen Familie! Wir haben uns rundum wohlgefühlt. Man hat sehr nette Gespräche führen können und ganz viele Tipps bekommen. Das Frühstück ist bombe! kommen sehr sehr gerne wieder 🙂🥰

Brendan's a funny, authentic and helpful host who has good tips for your stay. Also he is open for nice conversation and entertainment. Room has its own bathroom and was clean and had all you need. Pubs and restaurants are in a short distance walk.
