Our second blissful visit to the Studio! Thank you for sharing the magic of Ballyshane! Don’t hesitate, just book!
The Townhouse is an excellent property and a perfect base to explore Westport, located within walking distance to town. Maura is very helpful and always available should you require assistance.
This is a great place to stay! Michael is very friendly and helpful. The flat is immaculate and in a quiet area. Just a short walk into Killarney. Highly recommend Michael’s place.

The most incredible accommodation on AirBnB. We booked this spot before booking the rest of our Honeymoon- it was that important for us to get. Peter is in a class of his own. The hard work, craftsmanship, thought, attention to guest comfort, and service puts this accommodation in another category. Peter was kind, knowledgeable, hilarious, and effusive. He went above and beyond for us, and you could tell how much he cared for his place. We were lucky enough to walk the grounds, meet some incredible people in his orbit, and truly feel like royalty. We cannot wait to make another trip, perhaps with another member of our family. You will not regret this booking.
Lovely place to stay and great for a family
Beautiful room. Unbeatable location. Fantastic staff.

Bruno a été un hôte discret et bienveillant qui a su nous mettre à l’aise. La chambre était spacieuse, propre ainsi que la salle de bain partagée. Le petit déjeuner était à disposition dans la cuisine le matin ; ce qui fut très appréciable. Nous recommandons sans hésiter !

I wish I could give them six stars. for one the hosts were some of the most generous people. They accepted our stay last minute and on a holiday. Not only that but they offered to feed us Christmas dinner. We spent a long leisure meal together talking and experiencing a traditional Irish Christmas. They were accommodating in every way. The room was large and the shower had hot water. We would definitely stay again. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

We had a fabulous stay at clo's house , it was perfect, lots of room , beautiful view , Clo was a pleasure to deal with, would highly recommend this house and the location was just lovely and we will be back again , lovely walks around Dunmore East just perfect .

Absolutely perfect. The attention to details, the hospitality, the comfort…. Nothing is forgotten. Hands down, this will be our favorite memory of our travels through Ireland and one of the best Airbnb experiences. Our only regret is that we didn’t book more nights.

Paraic is a very accommodating host with a great breakfast. His backyard had a trampoline which our toddler loved. A very nice way to experience Inis Oirr, which was fun and peaceful way to spend the day.

Absolute stunning location, breathtaking views, beautifully set apartment, very private and peaceful. Brenda was a fantastic host so helpful with information. She also left us some goodies which was great as we arrived a bit late in the day. The kitchen is well stocked with condiments again very helpful. Great stay definitely stay again. Only one negative I am tall the shower is tricky for the tall people. Other than that it was a fantastic stay. Highly recommend

We had a lovely week here. The apartment was well kitted out and very comfortable. The accommodation is in a good location to visit Dublin, about 15 minute drive to the park and ride at stilorgan and it was very reasonable (I think we paid about €15 total for 24 hours of parking - we were going to late concerts - and two adult all day roaming luas tickets). Jean and Sean were really kind and helpful - lots of tips and advice and friendly (they went over and above for us). we did some beautiful walks in the area and on the clear days had amazing views. The resident donkeys were gorgeous too!

We spent a truly amazing week on holiday at Rosclave. The photos on the listing don’t quite do the location justice; the view from the lodge across the islands of Clew bay is really breathtaking and changes throughout the day as the light changes and the tide moves. It’s a private and quiet spot at the end of a country lane allowing you to get away from it all but with Newport is only a few kms away for easy access to bars and shops. Our 2 kids (11 and 13) found more to do than I expected and spent time walking on the shore and catching crabs. We cycled the greenway to Mullaranny, walked Croagh Patrick and went shopping in Westport. Westport (and Newport) are really stunning, well kept towns and Westport especially feels vibrant and lively. The lodge was a perfect base sitting only 8km from Westport on the road to Achill Island. For keen cyclists this area is stunning - plenty of country & gravel roads to get off the beaten track and not much traffic around. Try some loops out to Achill, or through the national park at the Nephin range, or down to Delphi through a stunning lake valley. The greenway is a lovely way to get around, and overall pretty flat so also good for the kids.Thanks to Jane & Mary of the hospitality and welcome pack with breakfast. Rosclave really is a fantastic place for a visit.
Gavins place is really great, we had a great time and Gavin is great. Just great all around. Would highly recommend.

The Dunworley Coach House is very special, really wonderful! We had a magical time there! The hosts are excellent, knowledgeable, beyond hospitable. They know how to create an extraordinary experience.The four course roast duck dinner that Gilly prepared and Richard served was truly outstanding. The best meal we’ve had in Ireland to date. Gilly is a talented chef. So many little niceties…fresh eggs from the family chickens in the fridge, fresh veg from the hosts’ organic garden, homemade jam. The Coach House is nicely appointed. Bedding and furniture very comfortable and charming decor. We felt very at home there and would love to stay longer next time. Don’t miss this blessed spot above the glorious Dunworley Beach.
Beautiful cottage in an outstanding place. Mary was lovely host and knows the area well. We can't wait to return!
Great house in a great location. House is equipped with everything you need. Easy communication with Geraldine and Aine. Would recommend.
Beautiful house located very close to Midleton. Very clean and spacious, surrounded by gorgeous gardens. Lovely house and really enjoyed our stay!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Raven Hill. To start with the location is almost out of this world with stunning views over Loch Mask and up to the mountains of Glentraigue. The house is located ideally for visiting Kylemore Abbey and Westport as the drives bring you through typical Connemara landscape. The communication with Marion and Patricia throughout our stay was superb and we got a wonderful warm welcome with Halloween treats and a bottle of wine. The house was warm, and everything was perfectly prepared when we arrived. The kitchen is very well equipped, spacious and the view is just beautiful. The bathrooms and bedrooms are spacious, modern and leave nothing to wish for. I would love to visit again at a different season and would highly recommend Raven Hill.

Die Unterkunft von Sean war abseits des Grossstadtlebens. Die Innenstadt war zu Fuß in 20 Minuten gut zu erreichen. In der Nähe befinden sich Supermärkte und Pubs. Die Wohnung und die Umgebung waren sauber und gepflegt.

We had a lovely stay at Jennifers house in Dungarvan. Plenty of space for 5 adults & 2 children. Although we did find the house quite dated. The property is located right on the edge of town, only 5 mins walk to bars & restaurants. It beautifully secluded but right next door to Minnies pub, across from Eurospar and 1 minute for the infamous greenway.The host Jennifer was brilliant, very quick to respond & very welcoming.
